title: Shadow War Demo
description: "Shadow War" is a 2D action game focused on combat with a Japanese-inspired atmosphere. Enjoy a variety of combat actions by combining normal attack combos, parries, guarding, and skills that consume Spirit.

title: Brimir: Pilgrimage to the Heart Demo
Timberworks Demo
description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

title: Outpost Simulator (Demo)
description: The world ended. Build a shelter for survivors, serve their needs to earn money, and defend your outpost from raids. Upgrade your base and your gear, and get a taste of rebuilding the wasteland. Welcome to Outpost Simulator DEMO.

title: Beat Weaver Demo
description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

title: RippleLoop Demo
description: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

title: Deskbound Raiders Demo
description: An ultimate slacking combo fusing action, idle growth, and desktop pet! Tuck it into your screen corner to start hardcore looting. Lead your Little Triangle against scheming animal factions and let your desktop host an epic underground adventure of conspiracy and treasure!

title: Bringers of Darkness Demo
description: Fight for the forces of darkness in this free demo of Bringers of Darkness. Play as the Succubus, master 6 unique abilities, and battle through the armies of light in Pinewood Village.

title: Football Manager: Auto Chess Demo
description: A football management game mixed with collection career play. You manage a themed club, schedule training, recruitment and league fixtures, then drag coach cards to command near-realtime matches as you climb from lower leagues to bigger stages.

title: Circulo Demo
description: Experience the geometric chaos of Circulo for free. Survive increasingly intense waves, collect resources, upgrade your character and experience persistent progression in this limited version of the full game.

title: Crease Demo
description: Fold the paper into shape. A cozy grid puzzler about creasing a sheet of paper until it matches the target exactly. 100+ levels, with fun mechanics.

title: 挂机英雄传 Demo
description: Idle Heroes Saga is an idle game where you collect heroines, form a team, and embark on adventures.

title: A Game About Being A Parrot Demo
Synemancy
description: Sling spells to overwhelm your opponents in card-based online duels, or immerse in a deep single-player story about the pursuit of knowledge and power, where every choice matters. Stake your very mind and become a Synemancer!

title: Whispering Eclipsia Demo
description: Investigate the mysterious Woods Lane Bungalow, uncover terrifying secrets, and survive the opening chapter of this first-person psychological horror experience.

title: Senpo Mahjong Demo
description: "This is not cheating—it's magic!" A free taste of Senpo Mahjong. Pick a partner from 8 characters and play unlimited matches against three CPU opponents. See through hands, control draws, boost your score—Skills cost MP, so timing your trump card decides it. No sign-up, fully offline.

title: Green Breach Demo
description: Navigate the dark corridors of a doomed space mining ship in this atmospheric sci-fi survival horror game. Search for resources, solve deck-wide puzzles, and manage your survival against persistent, lethal threats.

title: Avidy Demo
description: This is a Rogue-like action-adventure game. The protagonist, as an outsider in a remote town, is accidentally involved in a mysterious ritual.

title: Record of Chaos - Korean Chapter - Demo
description: Record of Chaos is a solo-developed roguelike deckbuilding card game inspired by Korean folklore and traditional Korean imagery.

title: MechBrawl Demo
description: Mecha Brawl: A pure tactics game made by a father & son! Packed with a kid's wild imagination, unique designs, and fun mechanics. Enjoy easy-to-learn, direct battles rich in strategic counters! Come help us expand this mech universe!

title: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn Demo
description: You know the rules. You still can't be sure if what you just saw was wrongness or your nerves. Take a room at an inn on the border of the afterlife and judge what slips in each night, obeying one rule more than the last. The demo runs to the third night. Past it, the rules alone will not save you.

title: Epitome Demo
description: Welcome to the system of Epitome. Explore a world woven from the threads of reality.Here, us, the Archons, my creations, rule over their unique realms, shaping and disorting them according to their desires.This is no mere adventure - enter Epitome and strive to become an Archon.

title: Forgotten - The Source
description: Federico only wanted justice for Jessica. What he found was far worse than revenge. In this first-person horror game, trust your flashlight, rely on your walkie-talkie, and solve puzzles that separate truth from oblivion. This story is the prequel to Forgotten - Whispers of the Past.

title: Kittycat Couture Demo
description: Kittycat Couture is a fantasy dress-up game about making outfits for cats. Style island residents, discover new designers, and fill your closet in this cozy game about appreciating fashion!

title: TETWORD Demo
description: TETWORD is a word-puzzle falling-block game across seven ancient civilizations. Rotate the whole arena, stack glyph cubes, and spell the target words to clear the board. Master real writing systems from Greek to hieroglyphs — solo or in local 2-player duels.

title: Shelves and Sorcery: Tidy Up the Enchanted Shop Demo
description: Restore order to The Hearth & Barrel in the Shelves And Sorcery demo! Organize over 1,000 scattered fantasy items at your own pace, unlock Sorceries and Enchantments, and experience the magical tools and satisfying organization of the full game.

title: Dicempo Demo
description: Dicempo is a dice rogue-lite where you roll for combos, stack stupidly strong upgrades, answer phone calls, buy Pushcards, and try to beat the next deadline before everything gets out of hand.

title: Lost Mind Demo
description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

title: Lock & Stone Demo
description: A dark fantasy adventure in a lost dwarven city. Unlock powerful Rune abilities, and solve puzzles to unwind the mysteries of the stronghold. Use your powers to battle ancient enemies and new routes.

title: Clicky Keys Demo
description: Clicky Keys is a tower defense game where your keyboard is the battlefield. Every key activates a weapon. Fight off enemies and make the right upgrade choices to survive. Can you reach day 20?

title: Avalon Jewels 3 Collector's Edition Demo
description: Play the free demo of this fantasy Match-3 adventure! Experience the opening chapter across 17 handcrafted levels, battle the Shadow King's minions, master magical powers, and choose between Relaxed or Puzzle Mode as you begin your journey through Avalon.

title: BURIED INSIDE ME Demo
description: What if you couldn’t wake up from your worst nightmare? BURIED INSIDE ME is a first-person psychological horror experience where you find yourself trapped within your own dream. Explore, solve puzzles, and survive yourself.

title: Fugue Shot: Minigame Roguelike Demo
description: 10 games, 1 roguelike. Face a gauntlet of arcade-inspired minigames and collect upgrades that affect all encounters. Can you defeat the Omens and find your way out of this ever-shifting dream?

title: FOIL QUEST: a TCG:RPG Demo
description: FOIL QUEST: a roguelike deck builder! Choose a hero, then build your deck as you go. Complete quests, face final bosses. Win or lose, your card collection keeps growing! If you've been wanting a new deckbuilder roguelike with a focus on combos and synergies, give FOIL QUEST a try!

title: 湖心茶铺 Demo
description: "Lakeside Teahouse" is a traditionally styled pixel RPG game set in a fully fictional world inspired by Chinese cultural aesthetics. Players take on the role of Li Zhulan, a young girl burdened with a mysterious curse.

title: Ball-Aqua Demo
description: Roll a physics ball through tropical obstacle courses. Beat the timer, collect bubbles and stars, and chase 100% clears. Play Freeroam solo or co-op, compete in Race, build levels, and share on Steam Workshop.

title: Lurking Demo
description: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

title: Ridge Hold Demo
description: Build a cozy fantasy village, train warriors and archers, and hold the high ground. Gather wood and gold between waves, fortify the stairs, and protect your castle in this cute 2D tower defense strategy game.

title: Painted Legend: Knights of Ink & Paper Demo
Woodland Rebels Demo
description: Survive an untamed world where humans, animal villagers and wild animals all coexist, but not in harmony. Craft, farm, cook, and assign roles to villagers. Explore various biomes and muster an animal rebellion to fight back against human invaders.

title: Card duel : Black rite 卡牌决斗 黑暗仪式Demo
description: Card Duel: Black Rite is a lightweight card roguelike built around Texas Hold'em hand-ranking duels. Use a wide variety of magic cards to rewrite the hand, strengthen your deck, choose among different fates, and ultimately win this dark duel.

title: Once,in Times of Chaos Demo
description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

title: Ranoka Demo
description: Command the dead in hex-grid tactical battles. Climb a 40-floor soul-devouring tower as Ranoka, a child necromancer born in its grave, raising fallen heroes, recruiting rivals, and uncovering why the tower hungers.

title: White Hound Demo
description: Run WHITE HOUND from a living guild office in the Free City of Azalea. Hire heroes, choose quests from the board, watch parties march a miniature quest map, pay salaries, fight Guild Wars, and chase fame in the Gazette... without leaving your desk of course!!!

title: Chronoscript: The Endless End Demo
description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

title: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator Demo
Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight Demo
description: Spell Cards aren’t drawn from a deck. They are ingredients you combine into new magic. Battle with four elements in this story driven, turn based roguelite as Ray searches the Tower of Starlight for her missing mother.

title: One Coffee At A Time Demo
description: Make coffee, tea and a reach of different bakegoods like Mud Cake, Lamingtons, Caramel Slice, biscuits, cookies, croissants and other Bakegoods. In your own little Cafe/Bakery.

title: The Yard: Escape from Prison Demo
description: An online co-op prison escape for up to 6 players. Follow the daily routine to avoid suspicion while crafting tools and planning your breakout under the guards' noses. Upgrade your stats and experience a tense atmosphere where you can cooperate to escape or compete to see who leaves first.

title: LEG DAY: Four Steps Through Hell Demo
座敷童カレシ ILOVEラーメン Demo
description: 《座敷童男友 ILOVE拉面》是一款体验拉面制作的同时享受温馨剧情的“恋爱喜剧文字冒险游戏”。

title: Precious Feather Demo
description: A short game where you hunt, feed, sleep, and repeat. Find the perfect feather. Keep husband happy. Pay rent!

title: qurld Demo
description: qurld is a 3D grid puzzle game where you paint a world made of cubes. Move in straight lines across the faces of the cube world and colour it all to win!

title: 七号楼 Demo
description: 《七号楼》是一款横版探索解密类游戏，在这个游戏中，你将扮演前新闻记者林述，前往已经废弃的七号楼，探索十年前棉纺厂三名女工意外死亡的真相。十年前，清坪市棉纺厂的三名女工在同一个月里相继意外死亡；十年后，一封匿名信把前新闻记者林述引向棉纺厂的七号楼。推开那扇生锈的单元门，这栋废弃十年的家属楼比他想象中更加黑暗。 欢迎体验《七号楼》demo版本，如果在游玩后有希望提出的建议或者反馈的bug，请为我们留下评论，你们的体验对我们来说至关重要，谢谢！

title: KickTheDungeon Demo
description: Kick the Dungeon is a card-based tactical roguelike game based on the SRD 5.1 rules. Assemble a unique party, tailor your own build, and enjoy the thrill of combat. Use cards to cast familiar spells like Fireball and Magic Missile — every run offers a different experience.

title: CircleBrawl Demo
description: Trial demo: a light-strategy idle sim battle game. As the "Sphere Lord," you don't control units directly. Instead, grow wealth through social activities, spend to unlock stronger spheres, and reap rewards in auto-battles.

title: The clutch Deck Demo
description: This is a turn-based card battle game where, upon defeating enemies with your deck, your cards can fuse together to forge a powerful deck that is truly your own. A diverse selection of decks and enemies infuses each playthrough with its own unique randomness.

title: 僵尸驾到 Demo
description: This 1-4 player cooperative horror game centers on breath and sound management. In darkness, every breath, step, and collision can expose you to the Lich King. Team up to gather resources, distract threats, and rescue each other.

title: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Demo
description: Turn the page on the explosive 2nd chapter of Nihon Falcom’s legendary Trails saga! Estelle Bright sets out on a new journey across Liberl to uncover the truth behind Joshua’s disappearance and defeat the sinister Ouroboros organization.

title: Legend of Deepshade: The Shattered Seal Demo
description: A classic grid-based first-person dungeon crawler inspired by the RPG greats of the 80s and 90s. Explore handcrafted dungeons, solve deadly puzzles, battle monsters, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath Deepshade.

title: Roguewake Demo
description: Roguewake is a spin-based pirate deckbuilder roguelite. Build a deck of synergistic symbols, turn each 5x4 board into a broadside, survive telegraphed attacks, and refine your permanent symbol pool between runs.

title: GO, STOP Demo
description: A roguelike deckbuilder played with hwatu, the Korean flower cards. Six nights from Busan to Daegu. Match the months, stack multipliers, and decide whether to call Go and double the pot or stop before the man across the table takes everything.

title: Body Kounts Demo
description: Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death. Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

title: Me, Bitten Demo
description: A lone survivalist, perfectly prepared for the apocalypse, just got bitten. Ridiculous? Yes. But you have zero intention of dying like this. Scavenge your surroundings for supplies to craft vaccines and weapons. Hold back the infection and wipe out the zombies. Survive. That's it.

title: Quartermark Demo
description: The first 100 floors of Quartermark. Your party fights on its own — you decide who is in it and what they carry. Everything you earn here carries into the full game.

title: SCP: Overrun Demo
description: SCP: Overrun is a tower defense game where you secure a shelter while being overrun by hordes of dangerous SCPs. While things may seem hopeless at first, there is always a certain strategy or hidden mechanic that may be enough to save yourself.

title: Director of Management: Football Club Demo
description: Choose your place in football. Play as a First Team Manager, Club Director, Club Owner, or Federation Executive in a living football world spanning 890+ territories, 60,000+ clubs, and more than 2,000,000 players and staff. Manage the team. Build the club. Own the institution. Govern the game.

title: Weed Inc. Demo
description: Play the complete Green Rush scenario from Weed Inc. Build a cannabis strain from fragments, introduce it to legal markets, and spread it country by country. Turn Consumers into Addicts while managing Side Effects and an escalating Global Response.

title: Pop Star Life Demo
description: Experience the first 100 days of Pop Star Life. Write songs, release music, perform live shows, grow your fanbase, and manage money, fame, stress, health, and relationships as you build your music career from nothing.

title: Captive 3000 Demo
description: First-person real-time dungeon crawler. Explore and fight through massive starbases and space stations. Grid-based movement. Traditional sprite design. Inspired by classic old-school 'blobber' games like Dungeon Master, Eye of the Beholder, Grimrock, and the Amiga/Atari sci-fi masterpiece Captive.

title: Train Trek Demo
description: Tower defense on rails. Wake the last war-train in a steampunk world that needs you: build your armored consist car by car, bristle it with turrets, and harvest fuel on the move as you hold the line across a vibrant frontier. Capture towns, upgrade your train, and follow a lone survivor onward.

title: Slice of Fortune Demo
description: Slice, squeeze, and sell in this juicy incremental game. Explore new locations, gather rare fruits, craft refreshing drinks, and drop juice bottles into your Plinko shop to earn coins. Unlock powerful upgrades and grow through a massive skill tree as your fortune keeps growing.

title: Willows: A Dream of Shadows Demo
The Stars Are Not Ready Demo
description: A neon arcade roguelite with no gun. Momentum is the only weapon: surf the dark at full speed and ram everything to wreckage. This free demo is the whole ten-zone dive, anomalies and all, down to the thing waiting at the end. The stars are not ready. Go anyway.

title: The Lost Bunker Demo
description: Is a psychological horror game set in the 1980s, centered around a cursed cemetery and a hidden underground bunker. A night of routine guarding turns into a descent into fear, where screams, secrets, and dark rituals blur the line between friend and enemy.

title: Slime Jump Demo
description: Slime Jump is a 2D precision platformer game where you explore a world full of hazards and can collect optional gems. There are 7 areas to traverse, two difficulties, cosmetics, and achievements. A grappling hook and blaster gun are needed for later parts. Can you rescue and reunite with your lover?

title: Swarmdle Demo
description: Swarmdle deals the same twelve minutes to every player on Earth. Same weapon, same map, same modifiers, same wave timeline. Survive the swarm, level up, and evolve your build. Share your results and find out whether your friends did better with the exact same draw.

title: Axomorph Idle Demo
description: Axomorph Idle, an idle biogentics game about evolving an axolotl from a cell to an ultimate axolotl form. In the demo, journey through the 6 different Axolotl parts and their Growth! If you love numbers, or axolotls, this game might be it for you. Try it out today for free!

title: Void Descent Demo
description: Jump in and try Void Descent for free! This survivorlike auto-shooter features quick, action-packed sessions. Slow down time to navigate dense swarms, experiment with millions of weapon combinations, and defeat the final boss encounter.

title: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage Demo
Spidoosh Demo
description: Swing into this physics-based spider battleground. Master your webs to swing, slingshot, climb, and build structures. Catch elemental flies to infuse your attacks with fire, electricity, and acid. This demo version is single-player only, but the FULL VERSION WILL HAVE ONLINE MULITPLAYER!

title: Bloody Lens Demo
description: Risk everything for content as you fight to survive a terrifying night in the yard of Hiraldo's Hospital. Escape the grounds to complete your first run, then re-enter the nightmare to hunt for your lost keys—a special, hidden secret is waiting to be uncovered!

title: Singularity Simulator: Click Is All You Need Demo
DOTS VS PIXELS Demo
description: POINT CLOUDS HAVE INVADED YOUR FAVORITE PIXEL ART APP. Up to 1,000,000,000,000 dots flow like a fluid, hunt your core and chew through everything you paint. Your only power: the pencil. Draw walls, survive the siege, unlock broken builds. BUILD. RESIST. OVERFLOW.

title: Wildlife Ballistics Demo
description: Wildlife Ballistics is a fast-paced, tactical top-down shooter where you kick down doors, clear rooms and neutralize threats. Fight tooth and claw to maintain order in the ever-decaying civilization of the forest.

title: The Internship Demo
description: Welcome to CorpCorp Incorporated. Complete your work, monitor your coworkers, and survive your internship in a surreal office horror game where something is deeply wrong beneath the surface.

title: Rites of Accord Demo
description: Outsmart your rival and win a full wargame in 30 minutes. Or attempt survival against (nearly) endless hordes. Command six factions that play nothing alike: turn your enemy's dead into ghosts that hunt them, spread living terrain across the map, or form choirs to share damage with allies.

title: Holiday Alliance Demo
description: Try the first three levels of Holiday Alliance free. Santa's armies are marching, and Rudy is the only one standing in their way. Place towers anywhere, deploy heroes to hold the line, and burn, freeze and shatter your way through the workshop.

title: Lone Sprout - Il Germoglio Solitario Demo
description: Manage the Lone Sprout outpost as Sylvain. Balance your needs, optimize the cultivation of precious Claritea, and trade with Eve. Use a gramophone to listen to tracks with unique gameplay effects and unravel an ancient mystery in this 3D low-poly rural survival game.

title: Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure - Demo
description: This is the demo for Ever After Again: A Stories Adventure. Once, armed with the Book of Destinies, Reynardo, a former sky pirate, unlikely hero and, according to a completely impartial source, incredibly handsome adventurer, lived through one disastrous future after another until he uncovered the Hero Path that could defeat the mad...

title: Exitus Demo
description: You have found the job you were looking for. Your only concern is your quota. or else? Protein was always the problem. The HFU solved it. Keep your head down, Do your job, you are here for a reason. Exitus is a terminal-style decision game. Pull up each case, then decide their fate.

title: Syr and The Stars' Revival Demo
description: Join the new Nextuber “Syr” and help revive the once-thriving Cyber World!Stream and gain fans to help the Cyber World flourish once again!A brand-new streamer raising simulation where building your room is the key to streaming success!“I'm going to become a Nextuber too — just like Spica!

title: Rogue Waves Demo
description: THE number one surfing roguelike deckbuilder! Fight for the best waves, build ridiculous combos, and outscore your rivals in the world’s least regulated surf tournament.

title: Shapes: The Tower Defense Game - Demo
description: Strategize your base to build and defend off waves of enemies in an on going battle. Plan, Attack, Defend and Grow! In the stratigic tower defense shooter.

title: Don't Mention B3 Demo
description: Work the night shift in an underground parking garage. Verify drivers, credentials, surveillance footage, and internal records, then decide who gets through. Remember: There is no B3 level.

title: Laboratorio de Videojuegos Demo
description: Play, create, and share 3D platforming levels while uncovering the secrets of game design. Learn by creating, overcome exciting challenges, and become the designer of your own adventures.

title: DSprite Demo
description: Start drawing with the retro game artists dream! A professional art suite that's easy to use, with the tools and charm of the best packages of the 1990s blended seamlessly with what modern pixel art and animation tools have to offer.

title: Arrownomics Demo
description: Arrownomics is a short incremental game about shooting arrows. Hire archers, build and upgrade targets, unlock new abilities, and boost your income.

title: Kinghold Demo
description: Command your king in a frantic real-time tower defense roguelite. Play cards to summon autonomous troops, construct buildings, and set traps as you scramble to defend your castle against escalating enemy hordes.

title: Apocalyptica Demo
description: Fight off starvation, dehydration, and madness. Lose your sanity, and your nightmares become fatal.

title: Ghost Receipt Demo
description: Run a cyberpunk grocery store and pawn shop in a neon-soaked city. Buy, sell, negotiate deals, investigate mysterious items, and piece together customer stories through the items they bring, the secrets they hide, and the risks you choose to take.

title: Trouble on Campus Demo
description: Trouble on Campus is a chaotic multiplayer social deduction game where students complete tasks, act suspicious, and try to survive while one of them secretly turns the campus into a disaster.

title: 電工らぶ -ゼロから始める電気工事士- Demo
description: 第二種電気工事士試験の学習ビジュアルノベル『電工らぶ』の無料体験版です。事故で命を落とした主人公が、資格取得を志す高校生としてやり直す物語のプロローグから、5人のヒロインとの出会いまでを収録。読み進めるだけで電気の基礎が身につく構成を、約1時間でお試しいただけます。製品版では5人それぞれのルート、公式過去問1000問と選択肢別解説、CBT模擬試験、暗記カード428枚をお楽しみいただけます。セーブデータの引き継ぎはございません。

title: Documancy Demo
description: An incremental management game where you use magical documents to empower an auto-battling warrior. Every victory unlocks a new document, introducing a new way to improve your warrior. What will the next one do?

title: Dust Vein Demo
description: A co-op horror game for 1-4 players set in the dead underground bunkers of Earth. Collect loot, fulfill the quota, feed the living reactor, and descend deeper and deeper into the mines.

title: Run While You Still Can Demo
description: Punch, Deflect or Run past enemies in this crazy runner game where you get to live freely or get sent back to prison for even trying to get your freedom. Multiple Zones: Blitz Past beautiful landscapes from hills all the way to industrial zones and city zones!

title: Chinese Black Dragon Legend Demo
description: " Chinese Black Dragon Legend" is a daily comedy Cantonese-style visual novel (galgame). The story follows Sino-French footballer Zhong Guolong's romantic journey with four heroines: Bai Xiaotong, Aisha, Frolana, and Kim Sung-ae.

title: Lucky Coin Pusher Demo
description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

title: 群琼逐鹿 Demo
description: 《群琼逐鹿》是以汉末三国为背景的轻量化联机策略游戏，2~4位玩家扮演割据一方的诸侯，寻访角色和道具提升自身实力，在玩家间的谈判、交易、结盟、背叛中实施自己的谋略。通过秦汉时期的骰子“博琼”判定各类随机事件，让对局在不断变化的形势中更具娱乐性。用谋略掌控局势，靠运气抓住转机，在群雄逐鹿的乱世中一统天下。

title: Broke Wizards Demo
description: From the creators of Scribblenauts comes a new  1-6 player co-op game where you and your Wizard roommates slay monsters, go racing, play prop hunt or do other crazy jobs to pay rent to a giant Imp Landlord before he eats you. Play this 1 hour demo to get a taste of the Wizard Life, and then buy the full game on September 8th!

title: Toey Weedz Forreal Demo
description: "Toey Weedz Forreal" Is a challenging, sleek and compact action game. A Comediac retro inspired Side Scrolling Shooter with a 3D Twist. Become Toey Weedz once again and raise your flag forreal!

title: Demonbane: Ascension Demo
description: Master elemental combat and mythic artifacts to slay demons and corrupted immortals in this fast-paced action roguelite inspired by cultivation myths. As the chosen mortal, grow stronger with every death to uncover the truth behind the Blood Moon.

title: Jousting Around Demo
description: Joust friends or random foes online in a horse-back driven rogue-like. Master both your sword and shield, each arm controlled independently.

title: Tiny Desktop Birds Demo
description: Tiny Desktop Birds is a cozy desktop companion game where cute little birds fly across your Windows desktop, perch on app windows, rest near videos, and quietly keep you company while you work, study, browse, or relax.

title: ODDSTABLE Demo
description: ODDSTABLE DEMO is a single-player horse-racing odds roguelite. Reveal imperfect intel, read fixed odds, build up to three tickets or risk everything on an ALL IN bet, then watch every race unfold. Buy and stack charms between races, clear rising bankroll targets, and survive a twelve-race run.

title: Shrine Protectors Demo
description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

title: HolyMoly Demo
description: Defend the Golden Cow through 20 chaotic waves in HolyMoly's free demo. Pick from 4 absurd heroes, build ridiculous upgrades, battle goblin hordes and bosses, repair your defenses, and survive solo or in 2-player online co-op

title: Hambone Alley Demo
description: The Last Alley — at the end, below all others — is littered with bowling pins. A disembodied grin invites you to play. Stack your deck of pins: explosive, gold, multiplier, and more. Chain their effects to level hundreds of pins per frame. This demo runs the alley's first ten frames.

title: Day by day：东京留子生存日记
description: A pixel-art life simulation about studying, surviving, and chasing your dreams as an international student in Tokyo. Every day, every choice, shapes your future.

title: Fille Fatale Compassion Demo
description: FFC is a retro-inspired JRPG with tactical battles. Help a young woman grow up and emancipate from her dark, traumatizing past.

title: Shenanigans Party Demo
description: A chaotic online party brawler for up to 16 players. Shove, dodge, throw and outlast your friends across 13 wildly different minigames, then scheme on the party board while a grinning demon host stirs up the chaos. Every round is fast, funny, and a little bit cruel.

title: Fleshgrinder Demo
description: An isometric tactical horror RPG. Fleshgrinder is a virus that causes an extinction-level event, harvesting DNA samples and trying to digitally accelerate evolution in the so-called Genesis Chamber after taking over the minds of the augmented population.

title: Bridgelands Demo
description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

title: First Light Demo
description: The entire first act of FIRST LIGHT, free — 33 fully voiced levels of a story-rich arcade brick-breaker. A grandmother's river town, told whole, from the first Tuesday to the First Forgetting. Play calm. The bricks are somebody's wall.

title: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator Demo
description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a gripping sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.Balance intense combat training, mech maintenance, and Lana’s fragile mental state to ensure victory.

title: Monty's Idle Mine Demo
description: A relaxing idle desktop companion game about a little cozy miner living at the bottom of your screen. Watch Monty mine, upgrade his skills and minerals to yield more coins, find or purchase his 142 little treasures, and decorate his tiny world. All while you work, study, or just relax!

title: Idland Demo
description: Turn a peaceful island into a giant ecosystem in IDLAND! Gather resources, automate production, and expand your territory block by block in this relaxing incremental builder. No stress, no rush—progress at your own pace and create the ultimate map.

title: Stormforge Demo
description: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

title: Starshapes Demo
description: A relaxing 3D puzzle game about drawing constellations in space.

title: Grandma Left Me A Building Demo
description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

title: Governor Demo
description: The Governor demo: you run a central bank. The full tutorial plus ten years of free play in the “Calm Waters” scenario. Three Carlin–Soskice equations under the hood, every lever unlocked from the start — your policy, your consequences.

title: HypnoFish Inc. Demo
description: HypnoFish Inc. is a first-person incremental game about working for the world's largest fishing corporation. Hypnotize fish, sell your catch, purchase upgrades, and uncover the mystery of this fishy business!

title: Nano Reef Demo
description: Turn every keystroke into a thriving ocean! Nano Reef is a cozy companion game where typing or clicking earns gold—without interrupting your work. Spend gold to buy marine fish, vibrant corals, and decorations, or feed your fish to interact. Build your unique, relaxing desktop aquarium!

title: Self Simulated Demo
description: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer about a robotic copy of yourself, waking up with no memory of a severe accident. Dash, dodge, and double jump through 100+ handcrafted levels, reboot instantly on every fail, and uncover the truth behind your past.

title: Night Hike Demo
description: Dive deep into the endless night in a puzzle roguelike where curiosity is your greatest tool. Discover hidden trails, encounter strange spirits, and uncover a way out.

title: Beep Below Demo
description: A cozy, relaxing game set in northern Spain. Take a metal detector and a shovel to find and dig up treasures. Each one will reveal new pieces of a story of the past, loss, and perseverance.

title: Liar’s Line Demo
description: A monster is hiding behind one of the voices on the line. Identify the liar before you reveal your location. One wrong judgment, and it comes to your door. Each playthrough changes who's lying.

title: A Ridiculous Waste of Time Demo
Project AsteroidZ Demo
description: A fast, retro-inspired arcade space shooter built on classic Asteroids roots. Blast waves of rocks, mines, drones, and alien fleets, chain combos for huge scores, and survive escalating boss fights — with full controller support.

title: Ave Goddess Demo
description: Ave Goddess is a fantasy action roguelike where you play as Einar, an envoy for an enraged god. Fight through one enemy filled room after another by casting spells using an unique system where you play a quick time event minigame to determine the strength of your spell.
developer: Jani Komu, Kaspian Seppänen, Anni Lipponen, Jeri Juntunen, Tiia Kvist, Sepi Heikkinen, Kasper Jaara, Emmi Uusitalo, Jaakko Varis, Leevi Vieru, Meri Antila, Pyry Pänkäläinen, Kale Nevalainen

title: Hammer & Harvest Demo
description: A dwarf farm sim! The days of dragons'-fire have ended, and now the Dwarf King has commissioned you to reclaim the ancient halls. Grow crops, harvest crystals, mine ores, and craft works of awe & wonder. Enrich your home beneath the mountains before the Dwarf King returns to judge your progress...

title: The Hunted Demo
description: THE HUNTED is a brutal wilderness survival simulation set in the Alaskan backcountry. Build fires, craft essential gear, manage hunger, thirst, fatigue, and exposure, and survive an unforgiving wilderness where every decision has consequences.

title: Dominus Gladiatus Demo
description: Experience the opening of Dominus Gladiatus. Recruit, train and equip gladiators, build your Ludus and make life or death decisions as you begin your fight against Rome’s rival Domini.

title: Yathsel Demo
description: Yathsel is a Wild West dice roguelite: play crooked Yahtzee-style hands, sneak loaded artifact dice from the smuggler under the table, and cheat your way past gunslinging rivals in a solo campaign, quick duels, and online saloons with ranked 1v1 for up to 8 players.

title: Forsaken Trials Demo
description: Seven training levels teach the movement system. Two Temple levels test it. Sprint builds momentum, jump height is fixed, distance depends on your speed at takeoff, and there's no air control. One mistake means death. Restart instantly, earn a medal, chase your best time.

title: Wheat Awn: Line Zero Demo
description: Wheat Awn: Line Zero is a single-player military strategy game about raising an army for the next impossible battle. Earn Star Coins in the Live-Fire Trial, recruit officers, buy supplies, expand your formation, master tactical cards at the Academy, then take Line Zero into 15 boss warzones.

title: Tailgate Demo
description: Have a bite at the first chapter of Tailgate, Sniff around and Find out! Step into Hyde's paws, explore the eerily empty village of San Pedro, and start unraveling the mystery of your Human’s disappearance.

title: Bao Bao's Cozy Cleaning Services Demo
老板说问题不大 试玩版
description: 睁开眼，面前是一张符纸，一条闹鬼的巷子，一个委托，以及…一位不靠谱的无良老板。躲藏、交涉、收集线索，在谎言中寻找真相，诙谐与惊悚交织。当死亡也成为武器，一次次带着轮回的记忆重新来过，而这次，你走向的结局是…？

title: AFTER THE SILENCE Demo
description: Alone at a remote observatory, you must manage equipment, investigate mysterious transmissions, and survive the unsettling events that follow every signal. Maintain satellites, process incoming data, explore the station, and uncover secrets hidden beyond the univers.

title: Ascend Pixel Dungeon Demo
description: Free demo of Ascend Pixel Dungeon — a pixel-art turn-based dungeon crawler. Explore the jungle opening, fight with spellbooks, absorb factors into adaptations, forge at the bonfire, and face equipped monsters.

title: Break the Bank Demo
description: Demo for Break the Bank, an incremental clicker game where you watch balls bounce through boards and break buildings for money. Upgrade, automate, unlock new buildings, and watch the number grow.

title: NeoRunners Demo
description: NeoRunners is a playable cyberpunk comic and roguelite deckbuilder. Combine 🔥 Burn, ⚡ Volt, and 💧 Flow into explosive reactions, then build relationships that unlock new cards, modifications, services, and story paths.

title: Cute Contra Demo
description: Meng Dou Luo is a hand-drawn 2D run-and-gun platformer for solo or local co-op play. Fight, explore, and collect butterflies, coins, and notes to trade with unusual NPCs for extra lives, rewards, and healing. The demo includes the first stage and a bonus challenge.

title: Davy bones Demo
description: Davy Bones is a strategic roguelike Yacht Dice game. Players roll dice for points and gold, purchasing relics and consumables to create synergies. As you progress, you must adapt to challenging bosses whose unique mechanics nullify specific dice faces or scoring categories.

title: Aera in the Ink Realm Demo
description: Enter cursed books, fight broken stories, and rescue five lost friends in a dark fantasy action RPG.

title: SubSurvival: SSN-13 "Grendel" Demo
description: A deep, detailed combat submarine simulator with a lo-fi aesthetic. Manage crew, nuclear reactor, radio, sonar, radar and power all while remaining undetected and completing the mission.

title: JMT -DUeL- Demo
description: A super-serious Rock-Paper-Scissors game, JMT DUeL. Rock-Paper-Scissors + Stats + Skills + Transparent AI Patterns. It will rewire your Rock-Paper-Scissors brain. Let's Duel!

title: One Gun Army Demo
description: One gun to conquer the universe. Every trigger squeeze, mag dump, and slam on the bolt release inches you closer and closer to full domination in this incremental idler.

title: NeonBound Demo
description: NeonBound is a parkour platformer with a dynamic soundtrack synced to player movement. Dominate the leaderboards with quick and precise platforming skills. Or turn off the HUD and parkour through an endless obstacle course at a relaxing pace.

title: Rodent Rampage Demo
description: Rodent Rampage is a third-person hero shooter. Combine nitrous boosted ground maneuvers, soda powered aerial attacks, and quirky in game power ups in a one-of-a-kind, PvP combat experience.

title: MachWire Demo
description: MachWire is a single-player speedrunning platformer where you use a variety of tools to get the best time!

title: Roscarian Defender Demo
description: Roscarian Defenders Demo is a 2D top-down twin-stick shooter where your goal is to survive as many rounds as possible. To progress to the next round, you must kill every enemy. As the rounds progress, enemies become tougher and more dangerous.

title: Rhythm Game Studio Demo
description: Get a taste of Rhythm Game Studio, a micro game editor designed specifically for creating your own rhythm games! With an easy-to-use block coding interface and robust rhythm-specific features, you can design and share your tiny rhythmic creations.

title: Path to Power Demo
description: Path to Power Demo is a political turn-based strategy with visual novel elements. Take one of four government offices, manage resources, legislation and the press, and survive eight quarters in 1992–1993 Kazakhstan.

title: Chest Looter: Monster Card Collection Demo
description: A chest-looting incremental game. Loot chests, collect unique cards, and gain endless upgrades. Unlock stronger packs, discover more powerful cards, and keep expanding your collection without end.

title: Born for the Light ~Wavelength Radiant Collapse~ Demo
The Peg Mines Demo
description: The Peg Mines is a pachinko incremental game about mining for ore using a deck of crafted balls. Mine for ore, craft new balls, and manage your arsenal as you delve into the mines!

title: Return to Planet Zoveka Demo
description: A physics-driven 2D incremental space-mining sim. Help a family herd cosmic dust, automate production, unlock research, and turn a single inherited station into a vast operation. Enjoy a relaxing, colourful journey to heal Zoveka.

title: Runback Demo
description: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

title: Star TD Demo
description: Command your defense in an ever-changing roguelite TD. Harvest resources from mine nodes, explore the fog of war, and repel alien waves. With a deep branching tech tree and permanent progression, every defeat is just a step toward ultimate power. Build. Die. Research. Repeat.

title: Cubic Color Confusion Demo
description: Cubic Color Confusion is a grid-based puzzle game where every move reshapes the board. Manipulate the environment and guide your cubes through ever more intricate puzzles to recover valuable artefacts from the ruins of a lost civilization. Can you master every challenge?

title: Magika Bounce Demo
description: Magika Bounce is a single-player, top-down action brick-breaker combat game. Play as a high school girl empowered by the North Star, controlling a ricocheting comet to shatter enemies. Face constellation-powered foes and uncover a hidden conspiracy.

title: Scared Numbers Demo
description: They have survival instincts. They have anxiety. They are terrified of your cursor. Hunt them down, exploit their herd mentality, and feed them into the shredder. It's mission-critical math in a world where nothing matters.

title: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite Demo
description: Build impossible scoring machines in the HYPERDROP demo, a hypnotising physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

title: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon Demo
description: A space adventure in the turn-based RPG genre with roguelike elements. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings new adventure. Space shows no mercy.

title: Time to Pay the Bills Demo
description: Time to Pay the Bills is a financial roguelike where you hit buttons with special marbles to earn money and pay off your debt. Combine different gameplay features to trigger combos and withstand rising bills.

title: No More Ground Demo
description: Keep climbing higher and higher across the city's rooftops. A high-risk, high-pressure action game where one fall means starting again from the beginning. Tackle obstacles using a variety of parkour techniques, such as wall kicks and wall jumps, and aim for the goal high in the sky.

title: Dice'n'Go Demo
description: Dice’n’Go is a chaotic multiplayer board game where luck starts the turn - but players decide how it ends. Sabotage your opponents, pull off clever ability combos, and turn terrible rolls into game-winning plays. Expect backstabs, dramatic comebacks, and last-turn twists.

title: Bad Grip Club Demo
description: This demo drops you into one of the game's four biomes. Climb a cartoonish mountain in VR with crossplay co-op, where physical grip and teamwork are your only hope. Grab quirky items, pull your friends up, and see how high your squad can get.

title: Architecture & Design Demo
description: Try the Demo: draw a floor plan, raise walls, place doors and windows, then furnish and paint every surface on a beach lot, with a selection from the furniture catalogue. Everything uses real measurements and is fully parametric. The full game adds many more functions, objects and much more to come!

title: Echoes of Mora VR Demo
description: Swim with your own arms through a mysterious sunken village in VR. Hidden in flooded houses lie traces of those who lived here. One of them is Mora. Follow her trail through portals to the days before the flood and help her find her lost brother. What you uncover could change everything.

title: Kaironia Demo
description: Try every Kaironia skill through level 20 in an old-school 2D idle RPG. Bank your offline time, forge equipment, hunt rare loot, and play solo or with friends. Your demo save carries into the full game.

title: I Want to Play the Villain! Demo
description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

title: Still With Me Demo
description: A psychological horror experience about returning to a place that never forgot you.

title: Soko Pirates Demo
description: Classic Sokoban in a pirate style with hand‑drawn pixel art - push crates, solve carefully designed puzzles, and relax in short sessions.

title: Grim Heart: Bleak Laments Demo
description: You are Hemwick, ex-witch hunter, chasing an ancient artifact: the Grim Heart. Ready your arsenal and survive brutal encounters in a handcrafted 2D pixel-art world. Your expertise is your greatest weapon and, ultimately, the difference between life and death.

title: Offering Demo
description: Offering is a relaxing, discovery-driven crafting game. Experiment with materials, uncover hidden recipes, and decide how to serve the mysterious deity who watches over you.

title: Venture Pals Demo
description: Choose your own Pal and venture out to grind skills and gather loot right from your desktop. Forge powerful gear, cook and brew invigorating meals and potions, and discover rare cosmetics. Manage energy, cleanliness, and training to grow. Or, just enjoy the company of your Pal

title: Phantom Demo
description: As an independent police consultant, you're pulled into the hunt for a serial killer leaving cryptographic ciphers. Play as a detective, analyze crime scenes, and master real decryption methods.

title: Re2 I Rise Alone - Demo
description: An interactive cinematic game featuring free exploration, real-person romance, and life simulation, packed with innovative mechanics: over 10 romanceable characters; a combat system; a drinking system; 2,000+ interactive choices; and 50+ unique endings.

title: Noosibirsk Demo
description: Puzzle-platformer with hand-crafted pixel art animation in the setting of post-Soviet closed city Noosibirsk. Explore the city full of wonders, acquire new abilities and solve puzzles to unveil secrets of the noosphere and escape to the world outside.

title: Spinful Demo
description: A fantasy roguelite slot-builder. Upgrade, enhance and customize your slots into a powerful combat machine!

title: Palace of a Thousand Curses Demo
description: Parry and thrust your way into a 2.5D action platformer with a unique style-based combat system. As you explore hidden passageways and duel strange creatures, you will need all of your swashbuckling panache to survive.

title: PuruPuru: Pull It Along Demo
description: Grab squishy little Purupuru with your mouse, stre-e-etch, and climb. It clings to walls and ceilings like a dewdrop. When the thread snaps, off it flies. The bigger the pull, the bigger the jump. Fall and your height is gone, but there's no game over. This demo includes the first two Solo stages.

title: DOGS of the DARK Demo Version
EVAC Demo
description: EVAC is the Worlds Greatest Helicopter Game. Complete explosive combat missions, high-speed races, rescue missions, and a variety of utility operations.

title: Tower Of Legends Demo
description: Climb a mysterious tower packed with thrilling parkour, clever puzzles, dangerous monsters, hidden secrets, and rewarding exploration. Master skill-based platforming, battle with your flying drone, and conquer 10 unique worlds across 45 challenging stages. Can you reach the top?

title: Operation Crimson Demo
description: A story-driven top-down action shooter. Venture into hazardous zones consumed by a biological catastrophe, battle mutated creatures of all shapes and sizes with firearms and melee weapons, and gradually uncover the truth behind the disaster as you advance through tense, tightly paced linear levels.

title: Nova Survivors Demo
description: Top-down space roguelite: hold off endless hordes and build your run from cards, artifacts and weapon evolutions. This demo includes the full World 1 campaign (15 levels, 3 bosses) and Survival up to wave 20, with 4 ships and real progression.

title: Hazel Rush Demo
description: You need to explore the world, outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

title: Mandated Fate Demo
description: A dystopian future-noir social thriller. As an Imperial Inspector, navigate a towering technocratic empire where loyalty is survival. Investigate secrets, manipulate factions, and make brutal moral choices. In this alternate history, will you uphold the regime or subvert the truth?

title: Apprentice Ascending Demo
description: Master forbidden magic. Dodge the rent. Survive the Tower. You are an apprentice wizard in a real-time card game brimming with terrible ideas. Pray for coin, study forbidden texts, and climb floor by floor before hunger and the Hunters close in. Seven fates await. Dare to earn the right one.

title: Das Hexencafé am Zürichsee: Der letzte Eintrag Demo
Idle Necronomics Demo
description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps working around the clock.

title: Royale Smith Demo
description: On this journey as a novice blacksmith, your ultimate goal is the kingdom. A loyal blacksmith devoted to the King will never fall. Plus, royal events will be waiting for you.

title: Hell Of War: Combined Arms Demo
Sectron Demo
description: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, buy off rivals with truces and tribute, and conquer each unique world. A game with simple rules where each turn should have a meaning.

title: Plink Lab Demo
description: Drop balls and watch the magic happen! In this highly-satisfying incremental plinko game, drop balls to smash through pegs and rake in massive amounts of cash. Use your hard-earned millions to max out the upgrade tree and unlock ridiculously overpowered balls. Start your ultimate dopamine rush now!

title: Dice Looter Demo
description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

title: FAIL GAMES Demo
description: Fail Games is a collection of extremely hard but simple minigames. Win each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail to buy effects and outfits. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

title: Xenomire Demo
description: XENOMIRE is a 2D sci-fi horror extraction shooter. Descend to a contaminated alien planet, complete contracts, gather loot, and extract before the horrors lurking there tear you apart. Upgrade your gear and create unique builds for each high-risk expedition.

title: Palehollow Hospital | 灰谷医院 Demo
description: This is a first-person indie horror game. You play as a video blogger exploring an abandoned hospital, uncovering the dark secrets hidden within its walls.

title: HACKING INTO EREBUS Demo
description: HACKING INTO EREBUS is a terminal-driven hacking cyberpunk thriller. Jack into a hostile network and outsmart ARIA, a surveillance system that watches your every move. Breach nodes, override defenses and pry secrets from a crew trapped in cryosleep. Fight your way into Compartment Zero.

title: Bacteria Buster Demo
description: Bacteria Buster is a fast-paced petri-dish cleanup game. Swat bacteria, upgrade your tools, deploy six Nano Robots, and develop four automatic Medicines. Clear a 200-stage campaign, face Super Bacteria and Bacteria Kings, then carry your progress into 1,000 stages of Endless Mode.

title: Flipocalypse Demo
description: test

title: Toilet 101 Demo
description: You step into the public restroom on Floor 60. Look around carefully, and make your way to Restroom No. 101.Don't overlook any trace of anomaly. If you spot an anomaly, press the elevator's X button. If you find no anomaly, press the elevator's ✓ button. Arrive at "Restroom No. 101.

title: IDEA:20Q Demo
description: A game of Twenty Questions against an AI running entirely on your own computer. Ask and answer with Ganymede and Europa — two beings piecing together the last records of a vanished humanity.

title: Napcats Puzzles Demo
description: Napcats Puzzles is a cozy puzzle game where every cat has its place — you just have to find it. Arrange cats of different shapes into a limited grid and solve handcrafted puzzles at your own pace.

title: 古咒迷途2渊海 lost curse 2 abyssal Demo
description: On a nightmare-devoured continent, players take a thrilling trip of trust and betrayal. Keeping the original classic JRPG turn-based combat, it blends fast-paced twist-packed shuangwen-style storytelling, delivering the ultimate thrill of uncovering truth in fatal fights against mimicking monsters.

title: Sange Demo
description: Sange is a fast, run-based isometric action game set in a crumbling dark-fantasy citadel. Carve through burning hordes, master a powerful arsenal of abilities, awaken fallen angels, and carry hard-won upgrades into brutal boss encounters.

title: ROBOSCAV Demo
description: ROBOSCAV is a turn-based extraction RPG where you command fully customizable robots into raids. Explore the planet, Scavenge for loot, Fight robots and aliens, Extract. After crash landing on a hostile planet, you must rebuild your spaceship from scratch, to escape.

title: Sudoku Mansion Demo
description: Play the opening chapter of Sudoku Mansion for free. Solve handcrafted Sudoku variants, explore the mysterious mansion, and uncover its first secrets.

title: Bokcuks Demo
description: Bokcuks is a survival farming game where you control a piece of poop.

title: Lightspire: Cards Demo
description: Lightspire Cards is a dark fantasy tactical card battler where deckbuilding meets board control. Summon units, fuse cards, exploit terrain, complete quests, and battle through Luna’s story-driven campaign of saints, schemers, monsters, exiles, and broken vows.

title: Sling or Spin: Miss and Done? Demo
description: One ball. One slot machine. Seven elements. Build your chaos. Fire the core ball, break elemental orbs, and fill the reels. Hit the right lines, push your score—before time's up. With 40+ relics and 40+ skills to combine, your way. Just remember—the more you risk, the wilder the spin.

title: YOU MUST SLEEP: Ravenous Nightmares Demo
description: Play through the first 2 Nights of "YOU MUST SLEEP: Ravenous Nightmares"!

title: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life Demo
description: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

title: PIGMENT LAB Demo
description: Chase colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land — the color difference is your score. This free demo includes all six Atelier Basics studies and the Scoop Challenge, with no play limit.

title: Doom ChessMaster Demo
description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

title: Sanitecty Demo
description: "A detective’s intuition alone cannot solve a case. Examine the scene carefully." Sanitecty is a 2D detective adventure set across various locations, from high-speed trains to hotels. Carefully investigate scenes and connect evidence to reveal the truth.

title: UniversiaTCG Demo
description: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes. Featuring an in dept visual novel for a lore filled story mode that covers each card.

title: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs Demo
description: The fire branch is open. Everything else is behind glass. Three maps, four towers, twenty-six thousand bugs — and the last tunnel sends twenty thousand of them at once. Learn to burn. Rot, frost and storm are waiting in the full game.

title: Walk in PENUMBRA Demo
description: Penumbra is a shadow-manipulating rogue-lite shooter. Step into the shadows for double damage. Navigate procedurally generated maps, create your own dark zones, and exploit the shadows of your enemies. A strategic "shadow-shooter" where positioning changes everything!

title: Iron Assault Demo
description: Play the first three missions of Iron Assault for free. Run, jump, and fight through hostile industrial zones, collect weapon upgrades, and defeat powerful bosses in offline single-player combat.

title: Rose of Dragontail Demo
description: Kick tail with tail! Join Rose, the scrappy fishing village girl turned half-dragon hero for some high-impact fantasy beat-em-up action. Kick, slam, tackle, spit fire, parry, swing your tail, and throw whatever and whoever you get your hands on to the groovy surf rock of Blue Wave Theory.

title: Torquonomics Demo
description: Torquonomics is a 6DOF physics shooter game from top down perspective.

title: Twenty One Point Demo
description: Twenty One Point Demo is a blackjack roguelike: spend Mana on Awaken and Artifact skills to reshape hands, deck order, and fights. Play Standard Mode and Roguelike with shop, Forge, events, and Boss. Demo: Xuanfeng Ke on Easy only—wishlist the full game for all classes and harder modes.

title: Insurance Worker Game Demo
description: Experience the first five days of Insurance Worker Game. Review client claims, examine their information, uncover inconsistencies, and decide which claims should be approved or rejected.

title: EmergenHex Demo
description: Solve combat puzzles with your build-crafted loadout, automate conquered nodes across a haunted hex map for loot, and upgrade your skills, passives, and gear. Master 60+ handcrafted encounters, then enter a harder phase where the rules change for all encounters!

title: Supply Yard Simulator Demo
description: Run the front end of a growing supply business. Stock shelves, manage inventory, and sell landscaping and construction materials to keep customers happy in this demo of Supply Yard Simulator.

title: DaiDee 大弟 Demo
description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

title: Sitarane's Legacy Demo
description: Descend into the shadows of the Tower, where only cunning and steel will ensure your survival. Sitarane's Legacy is an old-school, grid-based dungeon crawler that pays tribute to genre classics while introducing a ruthless modern competitive twist.

title: Survivor's Log: N17 Shelter Demo
description: Survivor's Log： N17 Shelter An alien apocalypse has begun. Manage your shelter, ration scarce resources, and face sudden crises and unknown threats. Every choice can save you—or destroy you. Survive until rescue arrives, or uncover the truth behind the invasion.

title: Untitled Shop Game Demo
description: About the demo versionThe demo includes all the features of the full game except for building walls and floors. These are only useful in your house on the left side of the shop, which is unavailable in the demo.

title: Pip Sellfish Demo
description: Draw a circle, reel up whatever is inside, and stock the fish shop on the beach. Your starfish cashiers sell your catch while you are still out fishing. Reinvest every coin into bigger circles, longer trips and a busier shop. This demo covers the first three fishing spots.

title: Ballakala Demo
description: Free demo of Ballakala — retro arcade paint shooter. Blast blobs, paint the arena, take down bosses. Short runs, high scores. Try the chaos free — full game on the store page.

title: Dead Party Demo
description: On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood raises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders!

title: Oops, All Tanks! Demo
description: Build a tiny 2×2 RPG warband, draft and upgrade gear, forge powerful weapons, then fight other players’ saved teams in asynchronous Ranked runs. Scout, adapt, and turn four questionable heroes into an unstoppable wall of tanks.

title: Miners, Moos & Miracles Demo
description: Miners, Moos & Miracles is built from the ground up as an incremental idle game, wrapped in a nostalgic retro-styled shell. Manage a small homestead (gold, barley, milk, eggs, and more), then hop between a handful of themed mini-games tied together by the same world.

title: Hackzshi -Hack and Brick Breaker-
description: It looks ordinary, but it’s crazy! Destroy everything with a bouncing iron ball! Use a variety of items to keep destroying an endless stream of blocks, zombies, UFOs, and even sushi! Aim for a high score!

title: Hellmate - Chess Deck Builder Demo
description: Roguelike deckbuilding chess in the seven floors of Hell. Each floor belongs to a deadly sin, and every sin crowns its own king. Summon pieces, sling spells, and brand your army with sigils to melt the king's HP before your turns run out. Seven sins, seven kings, one deck.

title: Crave New World Demo
description: Crave New World is a strategy sim about building an addictive drink. Buy compounds, rebuild the formula, collect Thirst from demand, open routes country by country, and turn consumers into addicts before Heat brings the operation down.

title: Solspire Demo
description: Embark on an open-world sandbox adventure through a vast voxel wilderness. Face monsters, ruins, storms, and darkness on an epic journey to the Solspire.

title: Shrike Demo
description: Pickpocket rival birds to build a deck. A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder about a tiny bird's grim migration north through a wretched medieval kingdom. Steal abilities, chart your migratory route, survive.

title: kowareta Demo
description: this is the free demo for kowareta. Experience the first half hour of the game and get a first look at its world, story, and combat.

title: Dragon Tiles Demo
description: Experience Dragon Tiles' core shop-building and auto-battling loop in this concise demo.

title: GAARL! - Gabe's Action Arcade RogueLike DEMO
description: GAARL! is a roguelike action platformer. Wield your chain gun to fight monsters in tense arcade combat, or fire it into walls to climb through handcrafted arenas. Buy upgrades, create wacky builds, get good health insurance, and unlock the mysteries of GABE'S ACTION ARCADE ROGUELIKE!

title: Neon Chaser Demo
description: Project: Neon Chaser is a "Neon Noir"-themed Drift Racing Game, featuring a Physics-based Driving system

title: Go! Dot. Demo
description: Go! Dot. is a minimalist logic puzzle game featuring sandbox-style decryption gameplay. Place blocks or alter the terrain in each level to help the ball reach its destination.

title: Breakfast Shop Legend Demo
description: Run a Taiwanese breakfast shop in this fast-paced time-management sim! Fry egg crepes, deep-fry nuggets, and mix drinks by hand. Every round ends in a frantic Rush Hour. Serve 31 customer types, catch dine-and-dashers, survive health inspections, and grow a roadside stall into a legend.

title: I Hate Polygons Demo
description: An incremental action game where you destroy polygons and grow stronger before time runs out. Repeat the cycle of growth and grinding until nothing angular remains.

title: Martial Soul Arena Demo
description: An action roguelite that blends personalized hero customization with high-speed hack-and-slash. Create your own unique hero and fight your way through endless hordes of monsters! Every run brings new upgrades, new gear, new possibilities — what kind of combat experience will you create?

title: Brew & Defend Demo
description: Brew & Defend is a medieval tavern management game with tower defense mechanics. Build your supply chain, grow crops, brew beverages, and place taverns along the road to satisfy a parade of thirsty customers before they ruin your reputation!

title: ANTA3 Demo
description: A cozy game about building houses for penguins on ANTA3 Island and helping the island grow.

title: Perfect Route Demo
description: Perfect Route is a physics-based billiards puzzle game. Plan each shot, use clever rebounds, and control your power to overcome handcrafted challenges and find the Perfect Route.

title: Conked Out Demo
description: British wizards duel with CONKERS! Swing across a spoof fantasy kingdom in this comedic 2D physics conker-deck-builder fusion. Play the Demo NOW!

title: 유해조수 Demo
description: A fast-paced 2D platformer with unique rhythmic movement. Play as an agile monkey sprinting through a dense and vibrant forest! Master the dynamic mechanics of grabbing vines and wall-kicking to navigate through the trees and reach the deepest parts of the woods.

title: IF Enemy: SMACK! Demo
description: Build your party and design their combat logic using If-Then conditions and skill rotations. Watch your tactics unfold in fast, RNG-free auto-battles. If you fall, analyze the enemy, reconfigure your setup, and try again. Solve the puzzle-dungeons and min-max your score!

title: PlanetOrbit Demo
description: Build your own 3D casino planet in space! Play Chinchiro, Blackjack, and Roulette to earn chips. Use your winnings to place facilities, customize your bustling world, and welcome unique alien visitors. Experience the core gameplay and start building in this early demo!

title: Last Ride Demo
description: Last Ride is a first-person paranormal investigation game. This demo includes the tutorial and one level. Explore an anomaly site, collect clues, identify the evil spirit, and capture it by following its rules.

title: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid Demo
description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

title: Infinity Bounce Demo
description: Turn the galaxy into a chaotic pinball machine in this physics-based incremental game. Rack up millions of points and do your best to keep the all-consuming space cat fed. Use planets, black holes, and manipulate space and time. Can you fill the cat to the brink of a big bang?

title: Can I Park? Demo
description: "You need to go to work. No—you need to leave work." You are trapped in a bizarre parking lot that constantly shifts in uncanny ways. Navigate through the space, avoiding dangers and unexpected hazards to make your escape. And uncover the hidden story.

title: Anomalous Backrooms Demo
description: The Anomalous Backrooms is a psychological observation horror game set in various portions of the backrooms. Study each room, decide whether something has changed, and choose the correct exit. Get eight right to escape. Make one wrong choice, and the loop resets.

title: Query Noir Demo
description: A noir detective game where every clue is hidden in data. Play a night-shift technician who cracks murder cases by asking the city's databases the right questions. No typing, no syntax: build every query from readable blocks, and watch the real SQL write itself.

title: Switcheroo Demo
description: A kangaroo named Jade escapes from an evil mad scientist who's obsessed with color! Along the way, she'll hop past vibrant obstacles, kick pesky robots out of the way, and use her new color-switching powers to solve the lab's mysterious puzzles.

title: 赤涵 Demo
description: 《赤涵》是一款百合文字冒险游戏。失去母亲的高中生王静，为了忘却过去而沉浸在两点一线的平凡生活中。然而在高二的开学典礼后，两个神秘的转校生闯入了她的视野，回家路上还被一个美丽女孩吸取鲜血，怪事频频发生，从此与名叫“赤涵”的生物纠缠不清，唤醒母亲的奇迹似乎触手可及……

title: Pin-Crawl Demo
description: Pin-Crawl is a dungeon crawling pinball rogue-lite! Bop, bash and dash your way through a dungeon of weird and wacky foes as you collect abilities and upgrades on your way to defeating the Evil Sorceress!

title: FlashTrainer Demo
description: Flashbang Trainer builds FPS anti-flash muscle memory via on-screen flash simulation. Driven by native RawInput with L-key 360° calibration for true DPI & sens. Pure transparent overlay—zero memory reading, injection, or game edits. Test build excludes custom presets, fuse, speed, angles & fade.

title: Litmustest Demo
description: Litmustest is a Horror Search Action game. Search every room, manage your inventory, solve puzzles and fight the dangers spawning from the depths of this facility. This demo includes the opening 30 minutes of the game.

title: Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers Demo
description: This trial version allows you to play the small and medium maps in the standard versus mode with a 6-month time limit. It supports local play between human players and the computer. More content, including campaigns, LAN matches, and online matches, is available in the full version.

title: K-Duel: The Anti-Cheater Demo
description: Face ruthless cheaters who break every rule. To survive this brutal tactical card battler, you must out-think the hackers. Position units down strategic rows and use instant fusion to evolve cards into colossal boss monsters. Fight hard, fuse power, and destroy the rigged system.

title: HR.SOS Demo
description: Your company is collapsing, and only you can save it. Play as both the HR manager and the CEO: optimize employees, rebuild workflows, hit KPIs, then transform your departments into an automated production empire. Expand your business and watch the numbers soar.

title: Soccer Club Story Demo
description: Build a football club from nothing. Start in the seventh division, recruit and develop players, shape your tactics, and watch every match play out in a charming voxel 3D stadium. Turn a small club into champions.

title: 爆弾天使ボムリエル-FOREVER THE KINGS- Demo
description: Bomber Angel Bombriel – FOREVER THE KINGS – is a top-down free-scrolling bomb-placement action/shooter that shares the same lineage as classic masterpieces like RoboWarrior (NES). It’s a fresh new game dressed in pastel, cute visuals—nostalgic in spirit, yet with noticeably improved controls.

title: Sausage Escape Demo
description: Sausage Escape - is a survival adventure where every mistake can turn you into minced meat. Play solo or with a squad of sausage fighters. Survive inside a dangerous house, complete objectives, and use teleporters, flamethrowers, and custom weapons across different game modes.

title: Idle Survivor Demo
description: Your ship is stranded and cannot move. Something out here has woken up, and it breeds faster than you can kill it. All you can do is upgrade your arsenal and fight back, wave after wave, for as long as you can hold.

title: VirtualLoveSecrets Demo
description: This isn’t your typical dating sim. Here, you’ll find the love of your life… or she’ll find you first. Every choice matters. Every word you say reveals who you really are. And while you think you’re getting to know the characters… they’re getting to know you too.

title: Orbitra Demo
description: Orbitra is a short, fast-paced incremental game that brings the tower defense genre to a planet under attack from space. Defend yourself against meteors, aliens, and increasingly bizarre threats from across the galaxy as you unlock powerful upgrades!

title: Bronzebeard's Tavern 2 Demo
description: Bronzebeard’s Tavern 2 is a chaotic co-op tavern manager where 1–8 players step into the boots of a young Papa Bronzebeard and family, traveling across fantasy regions to master unfamiliar cuisines, serve unpredictable customers, and prove yourselves worthy under legendary tavern mentors.

title: Stone Age Assassin Demo
description: On your night shift, gather fruits, craft recipes, and embark on periodic adventures in mysterious places.

title: Minatro Demo
description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

title: Sword of Mine Demo
description: In this skill-based platformer you have to climb your way up into the sky by balancing, jumping and swinging yourself from platform to platform until you reach your goal! Time your jumps, manage your strength, grab onto ledges, and use the platforms' unique mechanics to reach the top.

title: Darts RPG Demo
description: Darts RPG, the demo. An RPG set in northern England. Play darts. Aim high. Win the league. Save yourself from total destitution, one lukewarm pint at a time.

title: Northfall Demo
description: Northfall is a god-forsaken place where every dawn brings a new fight for survival. Explore abandoned territories, gather invaluable resources, and expand your camp. Face the infected and prove you can survive in a world that forgives no mistakes.

title: Colorful Boi 2 Demo
description: Jump, dash and wall-climb through the first 10 levels of Colorful Boi 2 - a tight, fast precision platformer packed with spikes, spinning saw blades and conveyor belts. Instant retries, a best time on every level, and a difficulty curve that never stops climbing.

title: Cyber Volleyball Demo
description: Cyber Volleyball is a side-scrolling 2D volleyball game with realistic physics and character progression. Players serve, spike, block and dig under strict three-hit rules. It features over a dozen characters with unique AI skills, adventure mode, online multiplayer, and nine upgradeable attributes.

title: MineMergeMatic Demo
description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

title: Rescue Incoming Demo
description: Survive escalating zombie attacks while scavenging supplies and upgrading your gear. Hold out until rescue arrives... if you can.

title: Please have fun in the dream Demo
description: A card game where battles unfold in dreams — use your wits and luck to win fun, exciting duels.

title: 内源之力 Demo
description: Action adventure role-playing game. Build equipment, strengthen, and break through. Step by step, we become stronger, with multiple instances and varying levels of difficulty. Each challenge builds a stronger version of ourselves.

title: Diaper Wars Demo
description: A chaotic multiplayer party game where unruly babies battle, compete, and unleash mayhem with ridiculous weapons, explosive combat, and wild obstacle courses.

title: 三國撞撞樂 Demo
description: A Japanese-style Three Kingdoms card-building game. Recruit, strengthen, and synthesize cards in a casual roguelike strategy game with ten-minute rounds; assemble the strongest team, engage in automatic battles, and forge your path to victory. This demo provides a complete single-player experience.

title: Bowerland Demo
description: Welcome to Bowerland, the single-player euchre-inspired roguelite card battle adventure. Take on the Bower King's sinister henchmen as you collect tricks, deliver damage and defeat foes to restore peace in the lands.

title: Hellforged Demo
description: Taste the chaos in the Hellforged Demo! Experience a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game, where every run is a tense heist. Battle demon hordes, pre-craft your build, and unleash epic synergies. Safely extract your epic gear mid-battle, or risk it all for legendary power.

title: Work...Or Fish? Demo
description: “Work... or Fish?” is a cozy idle fishing game that runs on your desktop. The cat took a long vacation to enjoy peaceful fishing—will you join? Shrink the window to fish in secret, upgrade gear, and relax in your own little corner.

title: Decrypting Life Demo
description: Decrypting Life is a short, nostalgic incremental game where you restore corrupted files to uncover a story from the 2000s

title: Roadhouse Simulator Demo
description: Go from bouncer to owner of a roadhouse in this prelude to Gas Station Simulator where you take on the role of the uncle and explore his humble beginnings.

title: DIY Store Simulator (Demo)
description: Run your own hardware store in this free demo. Stock the shelves, set your prices, and serve customers at the checkout. Order new stock, restock, and reinvest your profits to grow the shop, one sale at a time.

title: Kintsugi Moon Demo
