description: This demo includes the Rice Fields — one level from Kintsugi Moon.Platform through a moonlit rice paddy, collecting Mochi along the way to unlock the double jump and reach new areas. Scattered kintsugi shards are hidden throughout the level — gather them all to piece together a broken memory.

title: Zyrcon Demo
description: A mouse-only, endless sci-fi arcade shooter with dead-simple controls — just aim and auto-fire kicks in. Shatter asteroids into plasma cores, wield three upgradeable weapons, freeze time, and survive endless difficulty scaling.

title: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest Demo
description: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest DEMO - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

title: Invisum Piscium 嫌魚 Demo
description: Explore a familiar world that can never be fully understood.

title: It Works: Electronics Repair Simulator Demo
description: Step into the shoes of an electronics technician and repair damaged devices: receivers, phones, speakers, and more. Solder, diagnose, replace components, earn money, and grow your workshop!

title: PixaMixa Demo
description: PixaMixa Demo is a Windows desktop customization app. Add animated files, customize their appearance and movement, and turn them into lively characters on your desktop.

title: MOW (Minimal Over Wheels) Demo
description: MOW is a stylised and minimalist driving game where the rules matter more than speed. Easy to learn, difficult to master.

title: SHIRYU Model Photo Studio Demo
description: Arrange five SHIRYU papercraft models, move, rotate, scale and duplicate them, choose a solid, green-screen, diorama or custom-image background, then save your scene as a PNG. Experience the 3D models and controls used by ePaperCraft SHIRYU.

title: Cozy Home Designer Demo
description: A cozy decorating game with no pressure and no timers. Furnish rooms and gardens with 2,200+ items in soft pastel colors, invite adorable animals, and watch your home glow at night. Full controller and touch support, 12 languages.

title: Idle Archery Demo
description: Idle Archery is an incremental game about turning targets into money. Hire archers, buy tougher targets, stack upgrades, manage priorities and prestige for permanent talents that make every run snowball faster.

title: PachiRogue Demo
description: PachiRogue: Demo — a free slice of the physics roguelite where you fire balls down a cardboard board while undead hordes climb turn by turn. Draft stats, grow your hopper, bank gold in the Aquarium, and beat the boss. More levels are coming in the full game.

title: MOGUMOGU! POOP BATTLE Demo
description: This is the free demo version! Feed 🐰 and launch 💩?! A simple-control online 💩 battle begins now!

title: Crawler 3D Demo
description: A retro grid-based FPS dungeon crawler in a grim fantasy world. Fight corruption with magic and might, hunt bosses across varied lands, loot gear, and upgrade your skill tree.

title: Warpack Demo
description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills — forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

title: Puzzle Cottage Demo
description: Four of Puzzle Cottage's fourteen daily logic puzzles, free and complete: Weave, Bloom, Forage and Bramble. A fresh board for each every day, three difficulties, and a streak to keep. Solve by pure deduction — never luck. Your progress carries into the full game.

title: Greda Inferno Demo
description: A master potter arrives in hell under mysterious circumstances. With your skills, you must craft pieces for the inhabitants of the underworld. Survive, improve your creations, meet your new neighbors, and try to uncover the mysteries of the depths.

title: TowOrbs Demo
description: Build. Adapt. Survive. Forge the ultimate defense in this progression focused tower defense game where every choice can mean victory or defeat. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and endure the relentless Onslaught.

title: Abdication Demo
description: Fight through this corrupted monarchy in order to take the king's power and the crown, and destroy it to free the kingdom, all with a yoyo. It's too powerful to let anyone else to wield it, so protect it at all costs!

title: Horizon Idle Demo
description: Horizon Idle is a space-themed skilling & crafting idle RPG. This free demo is a complete slice of Sector 1: gather elements, research early tech, build and fight the sector's hostiles and its boss — with full offline progression. The full game opens nine more sectors, and endless progression.

title: Holy Mole Demo
description: Drill, collect gems and become the richest miner. Upgrade your gear, recruit helper moles... but be careful when night falls.

title: Impersonal Demo
description: You've come to your senses in a place that shouldn't exist. You have no face, no past, only two goals: to understand how you got here, and to find a way out.

title: The Manaworks Demo
description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

title: Rotoball Demo
description: Try the free demo of Rotoball, a challenging mouse-controlled action pinball game with a moving paddle and twin flippers. Rotate between four pinball tables, collect resources, complete orders and trigger weapons against waves of alien pests.

title: Warlapse Demo
description: War isn't heroism, it's ruthless order and maneuver. Across 7 ages from the Stone Age to modern times, encircle the enemy, cut their supply, and break morale to melt them in the killbox. Lead veterans through Campaign, dive into fast Skirmishes, or mod tomorrow's wars with your own units!

title: Can Collector Simulator Demo
description: Pick up piles of scattered cans in a casual first-person collecting sim. Recycle your haul at reverse vending machines, cash out printed receipts, upgrade your pickup speed and capacity, and look for oversized prize pull tabs hidden in the mess.

title: DiceBound Demo
description: DiceBound is a dark fantasy dice-building roguelike where you roll dice, bind soul, and forge your run to create powerful combinations, overcome enemy-imposed rules, and survive a branching path of Trials.

title: Witch War 1 Demo
description: Wage a war...with witches! Take control of islands one battlefield at a time in this team-based action roguelite. Play alone or with friends and become the last witch army standing!

title: Odd Job Angel Demo
description: A bitter RPG / Visual Novel where you travel the globe and help people! Every place you visit has its own job, and every day is a new opportunity to make friends!

title: Box Flow Demo
description: Box Flow is a cozy incremental packing puzzle where you scan, pack, seal, label, and ship orders while unlocking perks, automation, bigger boxes, contracts, and endless warehouse challenges.

title: Guild of the Tower Demo
description: Try the first five floors of Guild of the Tower for free — build your guild, program your heroes' battle tactics with the Gambit system, and see if permadeath is as real as we say it is.

title: Temporal Anomaly Bureau Demo
description: Inspect normal scenes, spot objects and actions that do not belong to the current era, professional workflow, or technology, then connect evidence and file your findings. This sci-fi puzzle demo includes 30 training cases and 30 timed challenges. Supports English and Simplified Chinese.

title: SKEW Demo
description: A first-person atmospheric exploration game set in dreamlike liminal spaces, with no monsters, combat, or jump scares.

title: Marketfield Idle Demo
description: Marketfield Idle is all about growing crops, selling goods, cooking recipes, automating production, and prestige into stronger runs in a cozy incremental farming game with strategy paths, and lots of synergies to discover.

title: 徘徊之碑 - Lingering Stele Demo
description: "Haven't seen you in forever." A narrative-driven RPG about the heart. In a peaceful world where all conflict has come to an end, is there still a chance to make up for the words left unspoken?

title: Ace Witch Demo
description: Ace Witch is an a party-based RPG set in an alternate, witchy version of Paris inhabited by fantastical creatures such as, elves, halfwolves and the French. Summon Card Demons in combat, and uncover how each character's backstory ties into the 'rage virus' that's been wreaking havoc on the locals.

title: Super Robot Survivors Demo
description: SURVIVAL ISN'T ENOUGHRepair reactors, hack terminals, rescue astronauts - all while fighting through relentless robot hordes where every decision matters.Juggle objectives while surrounded by hundreds of enemies.EACH RUN BUILDS TOWARD A FINAL SHOWDOWNTen-minute runs with clear objectives.

title: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents Demo
description: This is a Demo Version of Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents, a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

title: Shoku Pain Demo
description: Run a night-shift bakery inside a quarantine zone. Every customer looks human at first. Check their symptoms, fill the report, and make the call — bread, medicine, or the knife. Keep your supplies stocked and beware what waits outside the glass.

title: Dungeon Monster Master Demo
description: An action RPG set in an infinitely expanding open-world, randomly generated world where you collect monsters and enjoy boss rush battles Collect monsters to complete your encyclopedia and build your own farm while raising them

title: Patsy's Retirement Demo
description: Patsy just retired, and she's spending it on a tiny island that lives on your desktop. Watch her water the flowers, feed the ducks and sweep the leaves at her own gentle pace while you work. Lend a hand with quick optional mini-games, grow her skills, and unlock 170+ cozy cosmetics.

title: Market Panic Demo
description: Market Panic Demo is a free slice of a finance roguelite where you queue trades, manage clients, inspect rivals, and survive escalating market crises in a faster 3-year run. Build the portfolio before panic breaks it.

title: CardCollectorBattle Demo
description: A 2D turn-based auto-battle card collector built on a tight Battle - Roll - Fuse loop. Roll 288 guardians from Korean, Chinese, Japanese and Egyptian mythology, then feed duplicates into fusion to promote them. No microtransactions of any kind: every currency, every upgrade, earned by playing.

title: Novalex Project Zero Demo
description: Build a car empire from a single garage. Design every model from the chassis up, run the factories, price sharp, and outsell 30 AI rivals — a turn-based automaker tycoon spanning decades. Out-engineer the competition or go bankrupt trying.

title: Embermarch Demo
description: An idle guild-management RPG about the people you send into the dark — and what comes back. Draft doctrines, forge gear, and march parties down an endless night road. They level, bond, scar, and fall for good. Progress runs while you're away. The road remembers everyone.

title: Toll: The Ferryman's Ledger Demo
description: You are Charon. You take the coins from the eyes of the dead — and one of them, someday, must be your own. A short incremental with a real ending: five rivers, a tribute owed to Hades, and a price on your own freedom. It ends. That is the whole point.

title: 海边的忘川亭 Demo
description: Lethe Bar by the sea is a pixel-art afterlife sitcom. Play as AQi, a new Meng Po. Listen to ghost stories and brew custom soup using bizarre ingredients. Serve the perfect bowl to grant satisfaction or instant amnesia, sending souls on their way to reincarnation.

title: Pinballistic Demo
description: Pinballistic is a pinball roguelike set in a galaxy in crisis. Customize the board with special pinballs and unique components to discover insane high-scoring combinations. Unlock new spaceships that introduce game-changing modifiers and enjoy this haptically-satisfying, dopamine-producing machine.

title: アルタイル号の殺人 Demo
description: 宇宙船を舞台にしたＳＦミステリーゲーム。 とある基地の残骸を回収したことから、有人宇宙船アルタイル号の中で不可解な事件が巻き起こる。 被害を食い止めるべく宇宙船のマスターAIは、壊れかけのアンドロイド・フレムと共に事件の調査に乗り出す――

title: Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem Demo
description: Experience the opening of the MegaBlast Festival in this free demo of Eucalyptus Edge: MegaBlast Mayhem. Battle friends or AI bots in explosive local multiplayer, master powerful Chaos Bombs and power-ups, and discover the colorful world of Verdantia.

title: Road2Conquest demo
description: Road2Conquest is a two-player multiplayer game where you build roads to capture your opponent's castle. Use various strategy cards and game pieces to overwhelm your opponent with superior tactics!

title: Mecha Tower Defense Demo
description: Evolve towers. Level characters. Earn Skill points. Fail until you succeed and complete harder and harder difficulties. This isn't your grandma's tower defense. No two runs will ever be the same. Find the best synergies and unlock power with every achievement.

title: Soulban 2048 Demo
description: Merge. Split. Move Forward. Every puzzle demands planning and strategy. Merge and split numbers to find the solution and move forward, while making sure you don't block your own path.

title: Overprint Demo
description: The free demo. Survive the night shift at a possessed print shop. You pick your tool, clock in at 10 PM, and mow down waves of printer's devils until the morning edition ships at 6 AM. You level up, evolve your arsenal, get PRINTED or PULPED. A roguelike bullet heaven where ink runs. So should you.

title: Tetrogue Demo
description: Tetrogue is a roguelike where the Tetris board IS the fight. Line clears deal damage, tetromino shape and gem-augmented pieces drive your combos, and relics reshape every run. This demo covers the complete first stage and a taste of Metaprogression.

title: fCorvus Demo
description: Solve puzzles, uncover riddles, and hunt crows and ravens through layered scenes of mystery. Reveal the hidden truth in a world where every shadow tells a story. Learn about the fabulous corvus.

title: The Chaser's Voyage Demo
developer: Bright at Midnight: A Game Studio

title: Commutator Demo
description: A psychological horror you never see — you read it. Blinded, you sense the world through a neural implant: text and touch instead of sight. This free 20-minute prologue is one night in an empty clinic: scan objects, feel your way through dark corridors, earn your callsign.

title: Odysseus' 13th Ship Demo
description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

title: OpenSheet 3.5e SRD Demo
description: English Create, manage, and level D&D 3.5e SRD characters with powerful rules-aware automation. Build complex characters in minutes, automatically calculate statistics, manage spells and equipment, and keep every modifier accurate in a fast offline desktop application.

title: Last Lawn Standing Demo
description: Shape enemy paths with towers and barricades, then fight alongside your defenses as a garden gnome armed with auto-firing weapons and powerful potions. Protect bonus-granting shrines, upgrade your gear and buildings, face bosses, and survive 10 waves in this demo.

title: PHOSPHOR Demo
description: An action-packed retro cyberpunk roguelike platformer dropping players into an infested industrial abyss. Blast through hordes and giant bosses, and loot from 350+ weapons and upgrades. Every descent generated fresh. Die, keep what you forge, unlock operatives, and drop deeper into the PHOSPHOR.

title: One Neck Ahead Demo
description: In One Neck Ahead, you play as Kid Giraffe on a journey towards the heart of the forest, where dreams come true. Carry your own ground, create your own platforms, and meet a cast of memorable characters, each introducing a new twist to the adventure.

title: Chick'n Slide Demo
description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

title: Pirate Twist Demo
description: A top-down naval roguelite where your ship is a mobile base. The free demo sails the full First Sea: fight pirate fleets, brave the torch-lit Sea Cave, hold the port through a five-wave siege, and duel a boss captain. Come home richer — or don't come home at all.

title: Tiny Toppings Demo
description: Run the family pizzeria while Mama is away. Take control as Sascha, a teenager doing her best to keep the family business alive. Prepare pizzas, serve demanding customers, and keep the ovens running in this cozy yet fast-paced pizzeria simulator.

title: CasiYES! Demo
description: CasiYES! is a short incremental casino themed game where you rig the games in your favour and watch the numbers roll. The house always wins, because you’re the house.

title: C.A.G.E. Demo
description: This is a demo of C.A.G.E. – a satirical first-person narrative adventure where your choices influence the story. Navigate through corporate gaslighting and environmental oddities to complete your tasks. Your empathy is a glitch, compliance is your currency.

title: LEXICON Demo
description: LEXICON is a word puzzle rogue-lite that tests your word building and mini game skills as you traverse deeper into an abandoned computer terminal.

title: 1 HP DUNGEON Demo
description: 1 HP DUNGEON is a top-down action roguelike where every enemy and hunter has one breath. This free demo includes six seeded floors, lost spells to reclaim, weapons and Powers to combine, and two guardians: the Crystal Saint and the First King. Solo play only.

title: Zombie Cropse Demo
description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

title: Guess the Mess Demo
description: Sculpt strange prompts from clay while your friends race to guess what you’re making. Shape, carve, paint—and try to turn the mess in your head into something recognizable.

title: No Visitors Allowed Demo
description: A psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

title: Can It! Demo
description: Connect cans before they pile up! "Can It!" is a cute, colorful game where you piece together a variety of cans to survive. Reaction time and strategy are key to getting the highest score possible. Outpace the cans before time runs out!

title: Immune Simulator Type Z Demo
description: Immune Simulator is a card-driven survival strategy game set in a zombie apocalypse, presented in a retro CRT visual style. Play as police officer Jenna as you explore, fight, and recruit survivors amid a city in chaos — piecing together a chance at survival, one card at a time.

title: Plunderfall Demo
description: Start betrayed on a raft in this open-seas pirate twin-stick roguelite. Plunder resources, upgrade your hideout, unlock new vessels and weapons, defeat the traitor captains to loot their relics and unlock new waters, and rebuild your legacy.

title: TaskFall Demo
description: TaskFall is a co-op physics-based destruction game where you and your friends are assigned missions from the Citadel, survive deadly disasters, complete high-risk tasks, extract safely, buy new items, and smash through chaotic environments. Do you have what it takes to survive ?

title: Protect the Orb Demo
description: A survival defense roguelike. Keep the orb at the center of the map alive against a horde that wants it dead. Runs last 10–15 minutes. Stack 50+ upgrades into gloriously broken builds — burn, shatter, chain lightning, reshape the terrain. 40 enemy types, 10 maps, Ascension 1–5, endless mode.

title: Seina: a Tale Of Spirits Demo
Golden Retriever Simple Life Demo
description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

title: BREAKOUT BABY Demo
description: BREAKOUT BABY is a blood-pumping, Pac-Man–infused, first-person horror roguelike where you must help a poor baby escape to the surface. Run from creatures, scoop up pellets, and shake your baby to survive.

title: Bagchinko Demo
description: Bagchinko is a pachinko-inspired roguelike where you throw your medieval work bag down a field of pegs to meet contract quotas and avoid getting fed to the rats.

title: Loot Survivors Demo
description: Loot Survivors' free demo: the full game loop, capped at Floor 11. Fight endless hordes, then roll, gamble and upgrade gear across 10 rarity tiers and powerful Uniques. Two boss floors, real permadeath, no features cut. How deep can you get?

title: Alpha 7: The Last Hope demo
description: Alpha 7: The Last Hope: A frantic one-button bullet hell style space cyberpunk. Survive with Dave across different stages, master 4 ships, unlock 3 chapters of the official Lore, and enjoy a part of the original jukebox. An extreme, fully inclusive challenge.

title: Omanah Demo
description: Myst-Like 3D free exploration game. This demo allows you to play the first part of the game, which features 8 additional worlds in the full version.

title: Chesstris Demo
description: Chess meets Tetris in a series of handcrafted puzzles. Drop chess pieces to checkmate rival kings while avoiding checkmating your own. Your choices in and out of puzzles shape your destiny: become a beloved champion or a despised victor, find true love or ruin friendships.

title: Furry Defenders​​ Demo
description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

title: Working95 Demo
description: Point and click work simulator where you do office jobs, like spreadsheets, sorting files, making a ledger, and more!

title: One More Pearl! Demo
description: One more Pearl! is a relaxing and casual incremental auto-clicker game that combines auto-clicking with pinball elements. Play as a little sea otter, tap on shells, sell pearls, upgrade your talents, pay off your loans, and eventually become the richest on the island!

title: desert island time demo
description: This is a simulation business game that farms and digs ores on the island.

title: Greenrise Demo
description: Chop wood, break stones, mine gold. Spend it all on an upgrade tree, watch your island grow, then replant it and start over stronger. A short and cozy incremental you can finish in an evening. This free demo covers the opening, through two full replants.

title: Mystic 6 Demo
description: A tactical card RPG where each card strikes with a unique placeable grid pattern to outsmart your enemies. This demo lets you experience weapons, potions, skills, runes, and more as they shape your run.

title: Verbena: Tales Of Growing Up Demo
Dance of Theseus Demo
description: Dance of Theseus is a dress-up life sim set in the glamorous world of monster ballrooms. Craft new body parts, assemble yourself, and use dance moves to outshine everyone. Fit in. Stand out. Make friends. Fall in love. How many parts will you replace before finding your way back home?

title: Red Dust Colony Demo
description: The spirit of the space race lives on in this Mars based colony sim. Mine, craft and research in order to build up your initial lander into a self sustaining colony. Keep oxygen levels high and CO₂ levels low. Discover and grow a variety of plants to balance out colonist nutrition.

title: Pinly: A Plinko Roguelike Demo
description: Pinly is a Plinko roguelike where your gear is the board. Weapons fire when the ball strikes them; armor triggers when it lands. Buy, upgrade, and sell between waves to assemble builds that have no business working. Then drop the ball and watch the horde disappear.

title: CutBench Demo: AI Gameplay Clip Maker
description: Free demo of CutBench. Drop a 3-hour gaming session, get back ranked vertical clips with captions and ready-to-post titles for TikTok, Shorts, and Reels. 100% local on your GPU — no cloud. Demo clips are watermarked; the full version on Steam renders them clean.

title: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard Demo
description: The complete current build of DELVERS, free. Recruit a roster of hero classes, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot and named legendaries, grow a zodiac skill tree, and send a party of four into the depths to fight on their own. Haul the gold back, reach further. No caps, no timer.

title: Rift Protocol Demo
description: A tense, real-time squad tactics roguelike inspired by Aliens: Dark Descent. Command up to three soldiers through a procedurally generated facility full of monsters. Plan attacks, slow time for tactical skills, and scavenge to survive. One bad call and your squad is gone for good.

title: Astro Seed Demo
description: A brutal physics-based climbing game, where a robot tries to escape a cave using nothing but his awkward arms. A game for those who love to suffer... and overcome it.

title: Climb, Cube, Climb! Demo
description: Climb, Cube, Climb! is a cute rage-game inspired platformer where the primary obstacle standing in your way is gravity. Employ a diverse set of movement skills to ascend to the top, but be wary: falling is a guarantee.

title: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy Demo
description: DEMO - Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men. Uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

title: We Don't Exist Demo
description: A maze of cubic rooms. Traps that never forgive. A voice logging your every move. Other subjects ready to betray you. Officially, you don't exist… but the horrors you'll commit to survive — those will exist.

title: INFINITE CHUMP Demo Disk
description: INFINITE CHUMP is an ultra-fast, boomer shooter roguelite tripfest where you graft spell-casting arms to your body. Put rings on your new fingers to create spells on the fly. Inspired by 90's FPS games with a trippy twist.

title: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort Demo
description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic 1-4 player co-op defense game. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

title: Submersa Demo
description: Submersa is an underwater exploration game where you operate a functional submarine and manage its systems while exploring dangerous ocean depths. Control ballast, power, oxygen, fuel, and pressure as you descend into hostile environments.

title: Short Fuse! Demo
description: SHORT FUSEGather your convoy and hit the road through forests, canyons, mountain passes, sandstorms, and blizzards. Routes are extremely challenging, and the cargo is highly explosive. A true test for your vehicle - and for your friendship.DELIVER THE CARGO INTACTEach run has a goal.

title: Hope in the City Demo
description: Follow teenage Hope in the greatest investigation Shenyang has ever known. Her parents missing, their apartment in shambles, she is the only one in search of the truth. Use her artist's eye, find clues nobody would have seen, and transform sketchs into insights to uncover this city's secret.

title: Void Eaters Demo
description: Play as a powerful mage shaping an army of mythical creatures in this semi-idle incremental game. Destroy enemies and gather resources by casting spells or simply watch your army at work. Explore, upgrade, craft, and customize your forces to fit your strategy.

title: KNELL Demo
description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eight violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

title: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory Demo
description: Rare Metal War: The sins of memory Demo is an action game that combines heavy-mech combat, survivor-style progression, and story-driven exploration.WHAT'S IN THE DEMOPlay stages 1–3, featuring the prologue and the first survivor-style battle stage.

title: Chronoform Demo
description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

title: Sin or Suffer Demo
description: Sin or Suffer is a brutal mix of survival-horror and JRPG. Locked in a medieval prison, you awake amidst a cold silence. The guards are gone; inmates and madness own the place. Something terrible lurks underground. But the only way to the truth is down.

title: Meowmories Demo
description: A horror adventure about a cat and its owner. Awaken as a "cat" in a nightmare, hiding from monsters to reunite with your owner. Use feline agility to hide in small holes and high places, plus a risky "scan ability" to survive the dark and trace your happy memories.

title: Flame Cycle Demo
description: A soulslike open world, where the map constantly changes and your deck is your only anchor

title: The Universe of Death Demo
description: Hand-drawn isometric Diablo style rogue like with Elden Ring style controls, and it's also a tower defense. Level up in run to try new skills and builds, level up between runs to increase your stats to begin each run stronger. Acquire loot and give old loot to your towers and mercenaries.

title: Lucy's Nightmare Demo
description: A psychological horror platformer wrapped in a twisted fairy tale. Trapped in a nightmare, Lucy searches for the self she has lost — leaping through hand-crafted stages, evading grotesque monsters, and gathering memories sealed in scattered diamonds. The truth beneath is crueler than any nightmare.

title: Crypts Of Carith - Chapel Cellar Demo
description: Explore the village of Carith, dank sewers, forgotten cellars, and ancient tombs, battle deadly creatures, and uncover powerful loot in this classic party-based dungeon crawling RPG built on a familiar D20 system.

title: Mission: Clear Space Demo
description: A space shooting and navigation game

title: Pinball Realm Demo
description: A pinball Roguelite where the board is yours to build. Fortify your defenses, stack outrageous synergies, and unleash game-breaking combos as you save the kingdom from endless waves of monsters! This demo includes the game's first map.

title: Unburied Demo
description: A dead king's procession marches home, waking graves — stand in its way. 1-4 player co-op survival tower-defense roguelite: build by day, hold the keep together by night.

title: Orbisphere Demo
description: A cozy arcade idle game about one small astronaut alone in a forgotten corner of the cosmos. Slingshot around planets to gather stardust and spend it to keep your machines humming while you're away. Every idle hour is earned. The demo covers the full first zone: fly, upgrade, and wake the station.

title: Idle Demon Lord Demo
description: 【Idle Demon Lord】 is a dark idle loot game. Leave it running to farm endless drops — 6 rarities, gems, runes, relics, legendary affixes and sets. Craft hundreds of builds via skill trees. Online, offline and ascension loops. Codex, trials, pets, dailies. Pure number-go-up bliss

title: Tactorius Demo
description: Tactorius is a spell-driven chess roguelite. This demo puts you through the Gauntlet's first tower with a curated set of spells and partial access to the skill tree - summon, rewrite, and warp the rules of chess, and get a first taste of the runs that grow stronger the deeper you go.

title: Ouro Demo
description: The world has already fallen.As Earth’s last surviving defender, you walk alone across an endless, desolate bridge toward the inner city. Towering, extradimensional anomalies block the path ahead. There are no backup forces. Your only tool for survival is flawless defensive execution.

title: Tailgunner: The Allgunner Demo
description: Tailgunner, the Allgunner, is a JRPG, Inspired by classic PS1 games. Set on the distant planet of Valoria. In a Universe where guns are a religion, and War Is second nature, The Allgunner, the creator of the universe, Steps down from his podium In the sky, to intervene yet again with mortals lives.

title: KEYKRUNCHER™ Demo
description: Begin your fun and effective KEYKRUNCHER™ treatment in this free demo. Look down, follow the monitor, click the correct KEY, and KRUNCH. Earn enough Compliance Points before IT eats you.

title: Crimson Animatronic Demo
description: Choose paths, click, destroy your mouse, survive, and get disturbing endings. Play the prologue in this demo! Survive with Kiki Kirtz and Mini Ki on the streets of Baltimore, dealing and surviving with the vengeful animatronic Charkelene Chan and even worse creatures...

title: The Other Side of the Wall Demo
description: Julian Reed is a 13-year old student at a New England all-boys Catholic boarding school in the early 1980s. When people begin disappearing and no one else seems to remember they ever existed, Julian investigates, with the help of a girl he has never seen, separated from him by a wall.

title: Above the Haze Demo
description: A choice-driven visual novel centered on addiction, happiness, and the search for meaning. As a bartender in a rapidly decaying world, serve drinks and substances that shape your customers' fates. Experience their stories through minimalist 1-bit pixel art and an atmospheric liquid DnB soundtrack.

title: Flippin' Heck Demo
description: A puzzle-driven pinball escape room. Customize your table with new parts that unlock inventive combos and mechanics, then use them to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and find your way out.

title: Summon Defenders Now! Demo
description: The Defenders are relying on you to push back an invasion. Eliminate opponents for resources, summon and interact with a plethora of defenders to fend off the massive waves of invaders across different regions in this action packed, lane based tower defense game.

title: Tomb Zombies Demo
description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

title: Sunday League Manager: Horse and Spoon Demo
description: A Sunday League football management sim. Take a pub team of plumbers, postmen and knackered veterans from car-park pitches to regional glory — then lose the kit budget at poker. Try the demo.

title: Another Map Simulator Demo
description: Be the architect and the audience of a living, breathing fantasy world. Generate vast procedural maps, paint your empires, and watch as autonomous AI nations wage war, forge alliances, and build deep economies. Intervene as an active god, or sit back and watch centuries of history unfold.

title: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Mirror Demo
description: The final death blow to your remaining sanity! Fight your way through a chaotic city in this free demo and survive the rat plague in the subway station. Classic retro military shooter action, pitch-black humor, and maximum stoner-trash await you!

title: Planet Inc Demo
description: Serve as an executive of a planetary development corporation. Place buildings on a 4x4 grid and drive the planet's value to target. Rules that shift with every planet, a hard turn limit, and synergy between cards and corporate assets. A strategy roguelike where placement puzzles meet deckbuilding.

title: LSDos Demo
description: LSDos is a weirdcore-inspired, open-world exploration game where you are trapped in a computer, searching for any way to escape. Complete tasks and do an abundance of things to acquire the tools and expertise needed to leave safely.

title: The Clownhouse Demo
description: Break into a cursed mansion, steal everything you can, and escape before the Clown finds you. The Clownhouse is a stealth horror extraction roguelite with no weapons, only hiding, disguises, and nerve. Try the free demo solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

title: Same End Demo
description: Discover Dienna, a young reaper tired of dealing with troubled souls, who prefers to challenge them with trials where their lives are at stake. A platformer and Die and Retry runner game featuring multiple branching paths and alternative endings, hand-drawn in the style of a lightly animated.

title: VOXSHIFT Demo
description: Want to game, stream, or chat with players worldwide without losing your voice? VoxShift translates your speech in real time and plays it back in your own voice — not a robot's. Works with Discord, game chat, and OBS. 10 languages, noise cancellation, and soundboard included. One-time purchase.

title: Don't Lose Your Head Demo
description: Destroy your friendship by playing this challenging co-op game about two skeletons sharing a single head. Help each other to get out of a deep cave, be mindful of your jumps and remember - DON'T LOSE YOUR HEAD!

title: Last One Employed Demo
description: [Demo] Free demo, matches capped at 25 min. A cutthroat party card game for 3–10 players. Sabotage your coworkers, survive your inbox, and be the last one employed. One shared screen; phones are the controllers.

title: Anchor To Live - Demo -
description: ――Making a choice is synonymous with giving up.Raiden, a student harboring suicidal tendencies, skipped school every day, immersing himself in black magic.He cared neither about others nor himself, seeking to change something through black magic.One rainy day, he finally succeeded in a black magic ritual he had never achieved before.

title: RPG Incremental Idle Demo
description: An idle RPG: train 17 skills, master nine weapons, craft your own gear, unlock seven boss-guarded regions, and raise an Estate that works while you sleep — your progress keeps ticking even offline.

title: Bottle Flip Inc Demo
description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

title: Chalk & Blood Demo
description: CHALK & BLOODUn cadáver. Una habitación cerrada. Una sala llena de sospechosos que no piensan hablar. En CHALK & BLOOD no hay armas ni persecuciones: solo tú, la tiza y una verdad escondida en la geometría fría de la escena del crimen. Aquí la lógica es la única arma, y todo asesino comete un error.

title: League Of Transmigrators Demo
description: A roguelike deck-building adventure set across multiple worlds corrupted by unknown forces. Each world offers unique mechanics — from cultivation and martial arts to steampunk machinery and cosmic horror.

title: [Hell is Empty] Demo
description: The demo of [Hell is Empty] , a story-driven first person brawler about a monster fighting his way through a mysterious playground;-- full game release date TBD!

title: 種も仕掛けも思い出も【体験版】
BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya Demo
description: BE QUICK! The Rise of Fraya Demo is a cinematic boss rush driven by reflexes and QTE combat. Master enemy patterns, hit targets in real time, build combos, upgrade Fraya’s stats and survive the first three increasingly brutal boss battles.

title: Kingdom of Hope - Demo
description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

title: Beyond The Mist: Beginnings Demo
description: A romance-driven narrative about destiny, devotion, and the dangerous pull of belonging, set against the ruins of a long‑lost city calling you home.

title: Killdozer Demo
description: Destroy the town! Killdozer is an action roguelike where you bulldoze a town while surviving a police onslaught. Unlock items and upgrades along the way to build your Killdozer into the ultimate destruction machine.

title: Free Ball Demo
description: Free Ball is a third-person arcade volleyball game where every character has unique special abilities. Pass, set, spike, serve, and block your way through intense multiplayer matches that reward teamwork and precision.

title: EVA Awakening Demo
description: A cinematic VR psychological sci-fi journey into memory and consciousness. Solve environmental puzzles and make choices that reshape reality, as the line between creator and creation disappears. "My existence is not a mistake. It is a question."

title: Shotgun Jumper Nano™ Demo
description: Try out the original video game design by Super Amauri, try to stay airborne while shooting your gun in skatepark inspired levels.

title: True Nightmare - Diner Loop Demo
description: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

title: A Stray Line Demo
description: Chapter 1 of A Stray Line. Explore a strange world, draw to cast spells, and begin a story about a lonely little family in the woods.

title: PAPER.VOID Demo
description: Pilot a paper plane through an infinite monochrome dimension. Collect VOID Cubes, survive your own deadly trail, and face the END of reality.

title: Rolling Free Demo
description: A grapple-physics 3D platformer. You're a hamster tired of the wheel—so you flee upward, from cage to an antenna that leads to the moon. Swing, accelerate, nail your landings; when you fall, start over. The higher you climb, the heavier it gets. A narrator whispers: giving up is fine, too.

title: Chakab Demo
description: Explore a tropical island, uncover the secrets of an ancient Mayan temple, and survive the curse of Chak’ab. Solve puzzles, make meaningful choices, and face psychological horror in a world where reality and nightmare become one.

title: Something Strange Tonight - The Lurker Demo
description: You came to this house for a one-night babysitting job. As the night goes on, strange events begin to unfold, and nothing is as it seems. Can you protect the little girl and make it through the night alive?

title: Questmonger Demo
description: You are the quest giver. Run a guild from behind the counter: hear the townsfolk's troubles, hire the right hero for the job, and gamble your gold on their gear. Heroes die. Rent is due. The Crown is watching.

title: HueTrix Demo
description: HueTrix is a colorful block-stacking puzzle with a roguelike twist: clear lines to earn cash, then spend it in the shop on powerful mythic relics. Chain combos across seven colors, stack permanent upgrades, and build a game-breaking run. Easy to learn, endlessly deep, full controller support.ㄴ

title: Hunters Trial : One Breath Demo
description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

title: Code: Infinity Demo
description: After being trapped in an infinite world, I was entangled by seven men?

title: FLINTWILDE Demo
description: Let your character explore, fight, and survive on their own with auto-crafting recipes and proper gears In a 1-BIT monochrome world — a desktop idle RPG built around monster collection and character building.

title: A Knight's Fury - The Vaults of Venom Demo
碧海六重奏 Demo
description: You are a hero who saved the world, but you were killed by your own bride. Who is the mastermind behind the six girls surrounding you? Survival & Love Suspense AVG!

title: Evergreen Clicker Demo
description: Grow a thriving forest in this cozy incremental clicker. Plant trees, unlock upgrades, weather the changing seasons, trigger Forest Renewal, and build an ever-stronger woodland that keeps growing even while you’re away.

title: bansoko: Class Crossing Demo
description: An RPG-inspired companion puzzle game. Your commands reach your companions with a delay. Then class change with adorable outfits!

title: Forestless Demo
description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

title: Blue Guy Must Die Demo
description: Free demo of BLUE GUY MUST DIE — survive a short Forest run of auto-fire combat, upgrades, toxic bugs, and a boss fight. Then jump into Early Access for the full mission.

title: Escape the Exomoon Demo
description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

title: MOTA Demo
description: MOTA is a top-down survival horror game set in a surreal, endless maze. Outrun the monsters hunting you in the dark and escape by elevator, floor by floor. Grab random items, deal with rules that change on every floor, and push for the end of a maze that never looks the same twice.

title: MASSFALL Demo
description: Play a curated 12-stage slice of MASSFALL. Weld physical parts onto your ball to change its shape, weight, center of gravity, and bounce, then descend through varied pinball wells, build HEAT, bank it into SCORE, and face three escalating bosses.

title: VEINFORGE Demo
description: Mine coal, copper, tin, iron, and silver in timed expeditions, recruit assistants to gather materials, then return to the forge to smelt, hammer, quench, and sell equipment. Unlock mining and smithing upgrades through the complete incremental loop of VEINFORGE Demo.

title: AquaDesk Demo
description: AquaDesk is a relaxing aquarium simulation that turns your desktop into a living home for tropical fish. Feed, care for, breed, and discover unique fish through genetics and unlock new features as your calm desktop aquarium grows.

title: KILLPHRASE Demo
description: TYPE TO TERMINATE. Descend into a mechanical abyss and face waves of hostile machines. Choose your path and fight to the end of the line, or fall beneath the metal tide.

title: Group Idlemen Demo
description: Train Skills to 99, take on key bosses for RARE LOOT, Raids, & Expeditions. Control all 5 people in your group and climb the leaderboards!

title: The Fire Must Be Fed Demo
description: A short incremental game about feeding a mysterious fire. Harvest the forest around you and bring it resources, the more you sacrifice, the more power you gain. Unlock devastating fire powers and uncover what the fire really wants.

title: COLD AISLE: Data Center Tycoon Demo
Heretic's Rapture - DEMO
description: Hell is overpopulated and demons are escaping to Earth. Build a tower out of tetris-like shapes to create powerful synergies and send escaped souls back to hell, where they belong.

title: Naughty Nurse Demo
description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

title: Ship Graveyard Simulator 3 - Single Player Demo
description: Welcome to the biggest ship graveyard in the world! Check out what awaits you in the game and try the Demo version - grab your hammer, start up the heavy machinery, and experience the ultimate shipbreaking. Explore a living town, hire workers to expand your ship graveyard!

title: A Tiny Wander Demo
description: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

title: Rubber Bird Demo
description: Meet Rub the bird and help him answer the big question: why does he have arms? Jump, stretch, grab, throw, and mess up everything around you in this bite-sized physics-based platformer.

title: Destroy Buildings With Missiles Demo
description: An incremental physics-based destruction game. Destroy buildings to earn money. Spend money to upgrade your arsenal. Destroy some more buildings.

title: Sandcastle Demo
description: On a sun-warmed tropical shore, quietly craft a mighty sandcastle. Carve moats, raise towers and walls, then embellish with driftwood, pebbles, shells and seaweed. Gentle tides, soft surf and a calming color palette turn every build into a peaceful, relaxing moment. This is the demo for Sandcastle.

title: Beastfolk Barber Demo
description: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

title: Words Of Power Demo
description: Words of Power is a fill-in-the-blank rogue like deck builder. Construct sentences of devastating power and manipulate the sentences of your foes to turn the tides of battle!

title: Marblearium Demo
description: Experience approximatly 30 minutes of Marblearium, a flow-based marble adventure with satisfying physics and laid-back lo-fi beats. Steer a marble through nostalgic, interconnected tracks. Collect unique marbles and unlock new paths as the world grows stranger. Sometimes turbulent, always relaxing.

title: Cat Cafe Manager 2: Big City Bliss Demo
Flight Date Demo
description: A cozy logic puzzle game where you plan trips to reunite people in different cities. Characters’ requests and limited flight options make things more challenging. Create the best routes for everyone, unlock new cities, and enjoy a warm and relaxing journey.

title: Beards Go Underground Demo
description: The Mining Deckbuilder. Blow up the mountains using explosive card combos! Build your deck, prepare your strategy and BOOM! - call gold and gemstones your own.

title: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears Prologue
description: Play an exclusive standalone prologue set after Rainbow Billy: The Curse of the Leviathan and immediately before The Book of Fears. Help Billy investigate strange events, solve puzzles, and uncover hidden secrets before the ferry leaves for Camp Meteor.

title: Last Round at the End of the World
The Idle Captain Demo
description: A pirate idle RPG that runs as an overlay on your desktop. Sail between locations, fish, craft goods, brew, trade at the marketplace, and battle enemies while leveling up fishing, combat, and sailing skills in the background.

title: Little Sheep Valley Demo
description: Tend to a flock of sheep and build your perfect Mediterranean farm in this cozy ranch-builder! Decorate, expand, and create the perfect home for your fluffy friends. Yes, you can cuddle them.

title: Tony The Mole Demo
description: Play as Tony, a curious little mole with a serious digging habit, a taste for worms, and a dream of reaching the surface. Help townsfolk, repair gadgets, collect delightful hats, and explore hidden spaces as you uncover the story of Pebblegrove.

title: Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure Demo
description: Set in a whimsical snowy world inhabited by friendly creatures, Ice Pond: An Ice Fishing Adventure offers cozy yet strategic ice‑fishing with smooth pacing, rewarding fish fights, and light RPG elements. Manage your gear and pick your bait in a relaxing experience where every catch feels meaningful.

title: INURE Demo
description: Wrong man, in the wrong place, at the wrong time. Explore a hostile Dreamscape, manage scarce resources, and use whatever weapons you can find to survive a world shaped by cosmic dread.

title: DICEBONE Demo
description: You will not Die Today. You will Dice ! Control the Chaos, Escape the Ossuary, Or be part of the Bones... Forever.

title: Travelling Light Demo
description: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

title: Feed Me Harvest Demo
description: "Feed Me Harvest" is a first person horror farming game set in a eerie location. Plant crops, harvest , and feed the hungry head nearby to earn money. Use your rewards to buy upgrades, unlock seeds, and survive the night long enough to grow the key to your escape.

title: Dragon's Chronicles~双星のレギンレイヴ~ Demo
description: Dragon's Chroniclesシリーズは、シミュレーションRPGの伝統へのリスペクトと進化をテーマに掲げた本格派中世ハードコアSRPGです。伝統に基づいたオーセンティックな設計と、プレイヤーそれぞれの攻略や編成がゆるされる自由度の高い何でもアリの高い戦略性が好評を博しています。

title: 8bit Salvage Demo
description: Scrub old game art. Save the pixels. Clean through chaos. A calm, oddly satisfying incremental cleaning game: scrub the pixels off retired sprites with a spinning brush, cash in the salvage, and upgrade a tiny shop until tidy cleanup builds into a glorious storm.

title: Expedition: Into Darkness Demo
description: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval coop extraction looter. Craft weapons, customize gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

title: Echo Zero Demo
description: Descend into a dangerous, sci-fi underworld in this tower defense roguelike. Explore, gather resources, uncover powerful wargear and upgrades, build and defend your base, and battle a mysterious new species.

title: A Blind Step Demo
description: The Cult of the Flesh sacrifices people every 10 years. The Flesh consumes the victim and their memories of the world, thereby discerning exactly what its followers must do to solve their problems. However, by becoming dependent on the Flesh, they lose their cognitive freedom forever.

title: Frogs Aren't Fresh Demo
description: Frogs Aren't Fresh is a cozy, logic puzzle game, where you complete increasingly complex laundry orders! Take your time, and figure out the placement order to make sure everyone gets their clothes the way they like them.

title: Budget Defense Demo
description: During the day, he personally drove the war vehicle to attack the enemy. At night, he extracted oil to sell and use the money to build defense towers, working together to protect the base.

title: Wild n Chill Demo
description: Wild n Chill is a laid-back wilderness escape where ya forage, hunt, and craft the off-grid cabin of your dreams. Far from the noise and nonsense, it’s just you, your trusty companion, and a pal or two.
